'''Ernest the Chicken''' is a [[free-to-play]] [[quest]] where players must discover what happened to the missing [[Ernest]], who went into [[Draynor Manor]] to ask for directions and never returned.

It was one of the first quests developed and the first quest released after RuneScape's initial launch. 

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Veronica]], south of [[Draynor Manor]] by the gate.
|startmap = 3110,3330
|difficulty = Novice
|description = Veronica is very worried. Her fiancé went into the big spooky manor house to ask for directions. An hour later and he's still not out yet.
|length = Very Short
|requirements = *The ability to defend from a level 22 [[Skeleton]].
|items = 
* [[Spade]] (obtainable during the quest)
* [[Fish food]] (obtainable during the quest)
* [[Poison (item)|Poison]] (obtainable during the quest)
|recommended = 
*''(Members only)'' Fast travel to Draynor Manor ([[Draynor Manor Teleport]] or [[amulet of glory]])
* [[Food]] (If lower hp a lvl 22 skeleton and dead trees attack you)
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Ernest the missing===
[[File:Veronica chathead.png|left]]
Talk to [[Veronica]] standing just outside the courtyard of the [[Draynor Manor]]. She wants you to find her fiancé, [[Ernest]], who had gone to the manor an hour ago for directions and has not come back yet.

Enter the manor and climb up the staircase in the centre room. Then climb up the spiral stairs immediately west to find [[Professor Oddenstein]]. He will explain that Ernest was turned into a chicken when he was helping on an experiment with his 'pouletmorph' machine. However, to change him back, the professor needs parts that were stolen and hidden by the poltergeists in the manor.

You need to help him find a [[pressure gauge]], a [[rubber tube]], and an [[oil can]] in any order.

===Pressure gauge===
[[File:Pressure gauge detail.png|left|80px]]
To get the pressure gauge, [[fish food]] and [[poison (item)|poison]] are required. Fish food is in a blue box, one is found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} in the room directly south of the main staircase. Poison is in a green bottle, one is found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} in the small north-western room south of the kitchen.

Use the poison on the fish food to create [[poisoned fish food]]. Go to the south-eastern room (of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}), '''grab the spade''' next to the door leading outside (respawn every 48s), if you do not already have one to get the rubber tube. Leave the manor by exiting the door in the south-eastern room, go to the south-western corner of the manor grounds to the fountain. '''Use''' the poisoned fish food on the fountain to kill the piranhas then search the fountain to get the pressure gauge.

===Rubber tube===
[[File:Ernest the Chicken - Rubber tube.png|thumb|220px|The rubber tube and the skeleton.]]
[[File:Rubber tube detail.png|left|80px]]
On the west side of the grounds look for a [[compost heap]], north of the [[belladonna]] [[special patch]] near a patch of [[cabbage (Draynor Manor)|cabbage]]s. Search the compost heap, requiring a [[spade]] and you will get a [[Key (Ernest the Chicken)|key]]. Go back into the manor through the front door then go through the door to the room behind the stairs containing the [[aggressive]] [[skeleton]] and take the [[rubber tube]]. The skeleton will attack you, so if you are a low level it is recommended to get the tube and leave as quickly as possible.
{{Clear|left}}
===Oil can===
[[File:Oil can detail.png|left|80px]]
Go to the western room on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}, search the [[Bookcase (Draynor Manor)|bookcase]] on the western side on the wall to gain access to a secret room. Go down the ladder into the basement where there will be doors and levers around you. It is '''not''' possible to use [[Telekinetic Grab]] to pick up the oil can.

'''Note:''' The levers can be reset by leaving the room and returning.

Follow the steps given below to obtain the oil can:
[[File:Ernest the Chicken - Oil can map.png|300px|right]]
{{Checklist|
*Pull levers B then A down.
*Enter door 1.
*Pull lever D down.
*Enter doors 2, then 3.
*Pull levers B, then A up.
*Enter doors 3, 4, and 5.
*Pull levers E, then F down.
*Enter doors 6 and 7.
*Pull lever C down.
*Enter doors 7 and 6.
*Pull lever E up.
*Enter doors 6, 8, and 3.
*Go through door 9 and grab the [[oil can]].
}}
===Transmogrification===
[[File:Chicken (Ernest).png|left|80px]]
Leave the basement and leave the secret room by pulling the lever on the eastern wall.

Finally, go back to the top floor and talk to [[Professor Oddenstein]]. Give him the items, he will fix his machine which turns [[Ernest]] back into a human.
:'''Note:''' You are still required to leave the manor through the back doors.

{{Clear}}
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Rewards==
{{Obsolete|The image doesn't include the new quest rewards as of [[Update:Quest Month Kick Off, TFA Tweaks & More]]}}
{{Quest rewards
|name = Ernest the Chicken
|image = [[File:Ernest the Chicken reward scroll.png|centre]]
|qp = 4
|rewards =
*300 [[Coins]]
*Access to the [[Killerwatt Plane]] ''([[Members]] only)''
*An [[Antique lamp (Ernest the Chicken)|antique lamp]] giving 500 XP in a skill of the player's choice
}}

==Required for completing==
Completion of Ernest the Chicken is required for the following:
* [[Animal Magnetism]]

'''Imp Catcher''' is a quest involving returning [[Wizard Mizgog]]'s beads, which have been stolen by [[imp]]s.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Wizard Mizgog]] on the top floor of the [[Wizards' Tower]].
|startmap = 3103,3164,plane:2
|difficulty = Novice
|description = The Wizard Grayzag has summoned hundreds of little imps. They have stolen a lot of things belonging to the Wizard Mizgog including his magic beads.
|length = Short
|items = * [[Black bead]]
*[[Yellow bead]]
*[[Red bead]]
*[[White bead]]
|recommended = *''(Members only)'' Fast travel to the [[Wizards' Tower]] ([[necklace of passage]], [[amulet of glory]] to Draynor Village, or [[Fairy Rings]] to {{Fairycode|dis}})
|kills = *Multiple [[imp]]s ''(level 2)'' ('''optional''' unless [[Ironman Mode|ironman]])
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin.
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Mizgog's little helper===
Make your way to the [[Wizards' Tower]], south of [[Draynor Village]] and over a long stone bridge. Climb the stairs, and go up to the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}}. Talk to [[Wizard Mizgog]] and ask him questions to find out that he needs your help. He will tell you that [[Wizard Grayzag]]'s [[imp]]s have stolen his beads and he wants you to get them back for him. He needs you to collect:
*A [[black bead]] - {{Coins|{{GEP|Black bead}}}}
*A [[yellow bead]] - {{Coins|{{GEP|Yellow bead}}}}
*A [[red bead]] - {{Coins|{{GEP|Red bead}}}}
*A [[white bead]] - {{Coins|{{GEP|White bead}}}}

''Note: You can collect the beads in advance without starting the quest to save additional trips to the Wizards' Tower.

===Obtaining beads===
Beads are only obtained as a 5/128 drop from [[imps]], buying them through the [[Grand Exchange]], or trading with other players. Because of the relatively low drop rate, many players may choose to buy beads on the Grand Exchange to avoid the hassle of killing imps (for a total cost of {{Coins|{{GEP|Red bead|1}} + {{GEP|Black bead|1}} + {{GEP|Yellow bead|1}} + {{GEP|White bead|1}}}}).

If looking to collect the beads as a drop, imps commonly spawn throughout [[Gielinor]], and you might consider collecting them passively over time when encountering them. Alternatively, you can use some of the following hotspots where many spawn at a time:
*East of the [[Ardougne Monastery]]
*On top of the [[Karamja Volcano]] (be aware of level 14 [[scorpion]]s in this area)
*Southern entrance to [[Falador]]
*In a basement in [[Kastori]] (4 spawns in a 6x8 room, negates the inconvenience of teleporting imps)

Every 30–120 seconds there is a 25% chance for an imp to disappear into a puff of smoke and teleport a short distance away. Using [[Magic]] or [[Ranged]] is recommended to reduce downtime when killing them.

===Finishing up===
Once you have all four beads, return to Wizard Mizgog and give them to him to finish the quest. He won't accept them one at a time, so Ultimate Ironmen should plan to get the whole thing done at once. 
{{Listen
|title = [[Mizgog's Beads (Imp Catcher)|Mizgog's Beads]]
|align = right
|filename = Mizgog's Beads (Imp Catcher).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays while the cutscene plays.}}

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

{{Quest rewards

|image = [[File:Imp Catcher reward scroll.png|centre]]

|rewards =
*{{SCP|Magic|875}} [[Magic]] experience
*The [[amulet of accuracy]]
*After the quest players can obtain more amulets by speaking to Wizard Mizgog with a complete set of beads.
}}

==Trivia==
*If you examine the Mizgog's table before giving him the beads, the examine text will read "A table bearing a curious device". However, once you have given him the beads the text will read "A table bearing Mizgog's beads."
*Completing the Imp Catcher quest with level 1 Magic (7 Magic XP from Tutorial Island), the 875 Magic XP reward from the quest will land a player at level 8 Magic (882 Magic XP) with another 87 Magic XP to obtain before reaching level 9 Magic (969 Magic XP). 
*The colours of the four beads could be a reference to the steps of the alchemical {{Wp|Magnum opus (alchemy)|Magnum Opus}}: Nigredo (blackening), Albedo (whitening), Citrinitas (yellowing), and Rubedo (reddening).
*Beginning the quest with all four beads already in hand results in some special dialogue.

|name = Goblin Diplomacy
|number = 15
|image = [[File:Goblin Diplomacy.png|300px]]

'''Goblin Diplomacy''' is the 15<sup>th</sup> [[quest]] released in ''RuneScape''. During the quest, the player resolves a long-standing dispute among the [[goblin]]s of [[Goblin Village]].

==Details==
{{Quest details
|description = There's a disturbance in the Goblin Village. Help the goblins solve their dispute so the world doesn't have to worry about rioting goblins. Aim: to help the goblins decide which colour they will wear.
|start = Talk to [[General Bentnoze]] or [[General Wartface]] in [[Goblin Village]].
|startmap = 2957,3512
|difficulty = Novice
|length = Very Short
|items = * 3 sets of [[Goblin mail]] (obtained during the quest)
* 1 [[Blue dye]] (or 2 [[woad leaves]] and 5 coins to obtain a blue dye from [[Aggie]])
** Offer 20 coins to [[Wyson the gardener]] and he will give you two woad leaves
* 1 [[Orange dye]] – created by combining [[red dye]] with [[yellow dye]]
** 1 [[Red dye]] (or 3 [[redberries]] and 5 coins to obtain a red dye from [[Aggie]])
** 1 [[Yellow dye]] (2 [[onion]]s and 5 coins to obtain a yellow dye from [[Aggie]])
|leagueRegion = <poem>
{{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} — location requirement
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
Talk to [[General Bentnoze]] or [[General Wartface]] in [[Goblin Village]], in the Kingdom of [[Asgarnia]] (located north of [[Falador]], and east of [[Taverley]]). They will say that the [[goblin]] race is on the brink of civil war over armour colour, and they want their armour to be orange which is different to their normal colour.

===Gathering the required items===
'''''<u>Skip this subsection if you already have the items required.</u>'''''

Ask the generals where you can get orange armour. Eventually, one will answer that you can dye [[Goblin mail]] orange. [[Grubfoot]] will mention he stole yellow dye from a witch in [[Draynor Village]], and mentions you may be able to find it there. One of the generals will mention you can find goblin mail in three different [[Crate (Goblin Village)|crates]] around the village.
Grab the suits of goblin mail from the following crates:
*Behind the generals' hut.
*Inside the western hut in between the small square hut and the generals' hut.
*Up a ladder near the gate to the goblin village.
''Note: DO NOT dye 3 pieces of armour. You only want 1 blue and 1 orange. Leave one plain. If you mistakenly paint an armour you won't get new ones from the crates.''

Alternatively, goblin mail can be obtained as a drop from killing [[goblin]]s. The goblins in [[Goblin Village]] drop red or green goblin mails, which can be dyed, but you will need one uncoloured one from a standard goblin. You can go up the only ladder in the goblin village, up there will be some crates, search them to find a brown goblin mail.

[[Wyson]] the head gardener in [[Falador Park]] will sell you the needed [[woad leaves]]. Ask him if you can buy some. When you do, he'll ask how much you are willing to pay. Say, "<u>About 20 coins</u>," and he'll say you are generous and will give you two woad leaves. This is the cheapest option.

Two [[onion]]s can easily be picked from the field just north of [[Rimmington]], or from the backyard of [[Farmer Fred]]'s farm north of [[Lumbridge]]. One also spawns on the top floor of the [[Lumbridge]] [[general store]], on the table.

Three [[redberries]] can be purchased from [[Wydin's Food Store]] in [[Port Sarim]] for 3 coins each or picked west of [[Varrock]]'s [[South-east Varrock mine|south-east mine]].

===Making the dyes===
'''''<u>Skip this subsection if you already have [[Orange dye]] and [[Blue dye]].</u>'''''

You need to make orange dye and blue dye from the components you gathered in the previous section. Take the supplies to [[Aggie]] in [[Draynor Village]], and have her make one [[yellow dye|yellow]], one [[red dye|red]], and one blue dye. To make orange dye, use the yellow dye and red dye on each other in your inventory. Note: dying Yellow Goblin Mail with red dye makes Red Goblin Mail (and vice versa), so make sure you mix the dyes before using them!

===The generals' verdict===
[[File:Goblin Diplomacy - Grubfoot cutscene.png|thumb|Grubfoot trying the orange goblin mail.]]
Dye one [[Goblin mail]] orange, one blue, and leave the last one unaltered.

Go back to [[Goblin Village]], and give the orange goblin mail to the generals. They will have [[Grubfoot]] try it on, and say they do not like it. They will ask for blue armour. Give them the blue goblin mail. Again, they will have Grubfoot try it on, and again, it is rejected. They now want brown. Give them the plain brown goblin mail. Grubfoot tries it on for the last time. They decide that the original colour, brown, is best after all.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Reward==
{{Quest rewards
|name = Goblin Diplomacy
|image = [[File:Goblin Diplomacy reward scroll.png|centre]]
|qp = 5
|rewards = 
* {{SCP|Crafting|200}} [[Crafting]] experience
*A [[gold bar]]
}}

==Required for completing==
Completion of Goblin Diplomacy is required for the following:
*[[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals]]
*[[The Lost Tribe]]

==Transcript==
{{hastranscript|quest}}

* Three [[Crate (Goblin Village)|crates]], each containing a single [[goblin mail]], were added to [[Goblin Village]].

==Trivia==
* Until 17 July 2006, the quest was originally started by talking to the [[Bartender (Rusty Anchor Inn)|bartender]] in Port Sarim. This was perhaps meant to emulate other RPGs where players can start quests from random sources, by investigating a rumour overheard by a bartender or other random citizen.
* Grubfoot will remain in his latest outfit change when seen in [[Scrubfoot's cave]].

{{Goblin Diplomacy}}

{{Infobox Quest
|name = Lost City

'''Lost City''' is a quest about the fairy land [[Zanaris]]. A group of adventurers have set up camp in [[Lumbridge Swamp]], claiming to be searching for the mystical lost city. You must find the truth of this claim, and gain entrance to the moon of [[Gielinor]], Zanaris.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|description = Can you find the legendary lost city of [[Zanaris]]?
|start = Talk to the [[Warrior_(Lost_City)|warrior]] in the north-western corner of the [[Lumbridge Swamp]].
|startmap = 3150,3205
|difficulty = Intermediate
|length = Short
|requirements = *{{SCP|Crafting|31|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|no}}
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|36|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|no}}
*Ability to kill a level 101 [[Tree spirit (Lost City)|Tree spirit]] with limited [[armour]] and [[weapons]].
|items = * [[Knife]]
* [[Woodcutting]] [[axe]] (you will need to bank the axe before accessing [[Entrana]] - you cannot use a blessed axe)
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|45|link=yes}}
*[[Weight-reducing clothing]] and [[Stamina potion|stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s
*[[Food]] (armour is not allowed on Entrana)
*If using [[Magic]] for the [[Entrana Dungeon]] (recommended):
** {{SCP|Magic|13 }} [[Magic]] and enough runes to cast [[Fire Strike]] for the [[Tree spirit (Lost City)|Tree Spirit]] which has a 35% Fire weakness OR
**{{SCP|Magic|39}} [[Magic]] and enough runes to cast [[Crumble Undead]] against the Zombies and the [[Tree spirit (Lost City)|Tree Spirit]], who are susceptible to it (about 65 casts should be enough)
** A [[Celastrus bark]] to fletch into a [[battlestaff]] for the added Magic bonus (requires {{SCP|Fletching|40}} [[Fletching]])
* If using [[Melee]] for the [[Entrana Dungeon]]:
** [[Prayer potion]] (Prayer is almost fully drained when entering the dungeon)
** [[Ring of recoil|Rings of recoil]]
*If using [[Ranged]] as an alternative to Magic against the Zombies (not recommended for the Tree spirit):
**[[Arrows]], [[bow string]] and an [[unstrung bow]]
*Fast travel to several locations:
**[[Lumbridge Swamp]] to start the quest (plus one additional trip) - [[Necklace of passage]] or [[Ring of the elements]] or [[Amulet of glory]] or [[Lumbridge Teleport]]
**[[Entrana]] (1 trip) - [[Monk of Entrana]] on the second northern dock at [[Port Sarim]] or [[Balloon transport system]].
**An instant [[teleport]] to leave the [[Entrana Dungeon]] (the only alternative is to leave via the Magic Door to level 32 wilderness)
|kills = * [[Tree spirit (Lost City)|Tree Spirit]] ''(level 101)'' (Safespottable)  
* Multiple [[Zombie (Entrana Dungeon)|Zombies]] ''(level 25)'' (for a [[bronze axe]])
|ironman = [[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] The player is required to go to [[Entrana]].
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Varlamore}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Searching for Zanaris===
{{Map|name=Warrior|x=3150|y=3205|plane=0|r=4|mtype=square|caption=The start point.|align=right|width=200|height=200}}
{{Needed|A [[woodcutting axe]]}}
[[File:Warrior (Lost City) chathead.png|left]]
Head to the north-western edge of the [[Lumbridge Swamp]], just south of [[Draynor Village]], where you will find an [[Adventurers' Camp (Lumbridge Swamp)|adventurers' camp]]. Ask the [[Warrior (Lost City)|warrior]] why he is camped out here, and he will let it slip that he is searching for [[Zanaris]]. Ask who's Zanaris, and he will also let it slip that Zanaris is actually a hidden magical city. Finally, after asking him how he plans to find it, and then observing that it looks like he doesn't know, he will accidentally reveal that there is a [[leprechaun]] hiding in a nearby tree who knows how to get to [[Zanaris]].

Look for a nearby tree that only has a "Chop" option instead of a "Chop down" option. Chop it and a leprechaun named [[Shamus]] will pop out. Shamus will mention that the player will need to visit the shed in the swamp; ask him how Zanaris fits in a shed, and he will tell you that the doorway is a portal. However, to enter the portal you will first need a Dramenwood staff, crafted from a [[Dramen tree]], found only in the [[Entrana Dungeon]].

[[File:Lost City - Chop Tree.png|thumb|left|220px|"Chop", instead of "Chop down."]]
{{Clear}}
===The island of Entrana===
{{Needed|A [[knife]]|recommended=[[Runes]], a [[teleport]], [[Food]], and a [[prayer potion]] if necessary|skills={{SCP|Woodcutting|36}} {{Boostable|yes}} to chop the [[Dramen tree]]}}
[[Monk of Entrana|Monks of Entrana]] do not allow [[armour]] or [[weapons]] on [[Entrana]], but you can take:
* Items to make armour, such as a [[needle]], [[thread]], and [[dragonhide]] or [[leather]]
* Some clothing options, such as [[H.A.M. robes|H.A.M Robes]] and full [[graceful]]
* [[Celastrus bark]] to make a [[battlestaff]]
* A [[knife]] and [[logs]] (or unstrung [[bow]]), and a [[bow string]] to make a [[bow]]
* [[Arrows]]
* [[Runes]] (for [[combat]] and [[teleports]])
* [[Potions]]
* [[Food]]
* [[Jewellery]]
* [[God book]]s
* [[Blessings]]

{{Map|caption=The route on [[Entrana]] to reach the dungeon.|align=right|width=250|height=250|mtype:line,2833:3335,2845:3335,2848:3338,2855:3338,2855:3340,2858:3340,2859:3341,2859:3355,2856:3358,2856:3373,2854:3375,2842:3375,2840:3374,2820:3374,stroke-width:4|mtype:pin,2820:3374,title:[[Entrana Dungeon]]}}

Head to [[Port Sarim]] and find the [[Monks of Entrana]], south of the [[Rusty Anchor Inn]] on the second jetty. Use the nearby [[bank deposit box]] to store your axe if you still have it, and any other gear that violates the restrictions of [[Entrana]]. Speak to one of the monks to travel to [[Entrana]]. On arrival head east around the church, then north over the bridge. West of the bridge you will find a [[cave monk]] next to a dungeon entrance.

:'''Note:''' When you enter the dungeon, your Prayer will be reduced to nearly 0. Make sure not to have crafted any weapons before climbing down the ladder, or you will be kicked off the island.

Climb down into the dungeon, and kill the [[Zombie (Entrana Dungeon)|zombies]] (level 25) until one of them drops a [[bronze axe]]. There is a [[safespot]] by the mushrooms against the west wall, and another by the small group of mushrooms in the southern part of the zombie area. 

:'''Note:''' If using the [[Crumble Undead]] spell to fight zombies, make sure to save runes for 20-30 casts against the [[Tree spirit (Lost City)|Tree spirit]] later. 

Once you have obtained an axe, head south through the cave until you see some [[greater demon]]s and a small cave off to the south. 

:'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}: Do not go through the magical door to the east, it takes you to level 32 wilderness'''. 

Run past the demons to the south, and chop the [[Dramen Tree]] found inside ({{SCP|Woodcutting|36}}) - a level 101 [[Tree spirit (Lost City)|tree spirit]] will appear.

===Fighting the tree spirit===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Crafting|31}} {{Boostable|yes}} to craft a [[dramen staff]]}}
[[File:Dramen_tree.gif|thumb|100px|left|The Dramen tree.]]
{{Map|3204,3169|r=3|mtype=square|caption=Entrance to Zanaris.|align=right|width=200|height=200}}

If using [[Magic]] or [[Ranged]], you can utilise a [[safespot]] by cutting the tree from the south, then running inbetween the three mushrooms to the south-west once the tree spirit spawns.

:{{Color|red|Warning:}} The tree spirit will respawn after cutting the tree again if you kill it from outside of the room.

:'''Note''': [[Rings of recoil]] can be used and other players can assist in the kill, but the questing player must deal at least 1 damage themselves for the kill to count.

Once you've defeated the tree spirit, cut the tree again to get a [[Dramen branch]], then use a [[knife]] on it to make the [[Dramen staff]] ({{SCP|Crafting|31}}).

:'''Tip:''' A dramen branch is required for the [[Freeing Sir Amik Varze]] subquest of [[Recipe for Disaster]], and another is useful for the smuggling into [[Thorvald]]'s trial in [[The Fremennik Trials]], but do not make them into staves yet. Cutting at least three branches is recommended.

'''Teleport out''' and head to the [[Shed (Lumbridge Swamp)|tool shed]] in the centre of [[Lumbridge Swamp]]. Equip the Dramen staff before entering, and upon opening the door you'll find yourself in [[Zanaris]].

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===The greatest heroes of the land===
[[File:Achietties chathead.png|left]]
[[File:Heroes' Quest start.png|thumb|Speaking to the heroine Achietties.]]
Talk to [[Achietties]] outside the [[Heroes' Guild]] just south of [[Burthorpe]] about joining the guild. If you meet the requirements, she will acknowledge your questing prowess and set you the entry tasks. She will tell you that in order to get in you need to give her three items: a [[fire feather]] from an [[Entrana firebird]], a cooked [[lava eel]], and a [[Thieves' armband|Master Thieves' Armband]].

For the armband, she suggests you probably have 'relevant contacts' yourself with whom to enquire about it. To obtain the feather she only offers the most helpful advice that Entranan firebirds tend to live on [[Entrana]]. To get the eel, she advises you to talk to someone who knows a lot about fishing.

The items may be obtained in any order, but must be given to Achietties simultaneously.

===Master Thieves' armband===
{{Map|2771,3194|mtype=rectangle|rectX=24|rectY=12|caption=The location of Scarface Pete's mansion in Brimhaven.|align=right|width=250|height=250}}
To earn the armband, you will have to contact your old gang associates from the [[Shield of Arrav]] quest, as indicated by the quest journal. For this part of the quest, you will need the help of a player of the opposite gang. Players that have completed the quest may go back and help others. For finding a quest partner, the [[Grouping]] interface is useful. You can also usually find a partner on the [[chat-channel]] 'Osrs Soa' during peak hours.

:'''Note:''' For this part of the quest you '''do not''' need to meet the skill requirements. This means you can complete this part of the quest in order to help a friend complete their entire quest; see [[Heroes' Quest#Trivia|Trivia]] for more details. You can even help a friend if you have already completed the quest yourself.
:'''Note:''' Traded Pete's candlesticks will not be accepted if the presenter did not kill Grip. As such, do not get scammed into buying or taking free candlesticks unless you are a Phoenix Gang member and can kill Grip. Black Arm gang members can never kill Grip so they should not accept traded candlesticks under any circumstances. Likewise, a [[miscellaneous key]] without a Black Arm member to lure Grip is useless. Do not get scammed into buying miscellaneous keys.

=== Black Arm Gang member ===
[[File:Katrine chathead.png|left]]
{{Needed|A [[black full helm]], a [[black platebody]] and [[black platelegs]]}}

Go to Varrock and talk to [[Katrine]] who is inside the [[Black Arm Gang Headquarters]], which is situated in the south-west of the city. She tells you that you need to do something amazing in order to attain the rank of master thief. She explains some of the most coveted items for thieves are in [[Brimhaven]]. The leader of the pirates there is one [[Scarface Pete]]. She will tell you that you have to steal his very valuable [[Pete's candlestick|candlesticks]] and that his security is very good.

You have to visit the Black Arm members in their hideout in the alleyway of Palm Street. The gang's password is "''four leafed{{sic}} clover".''

====The Hideout on Palm Street====
Go to Brimhaven and find the gang office, which is the building along the fence, east of the two inns and south of the [[Brimhaven Agility Arena|Agility Arena]]. Give [[Grubor]] the password "four leaved clover" at the door, and inside speak to [[Trobert]], the leader of the Black Arms in Brimhaven. Trobert explains one of the only keys to Pete's treasure room is carried by his head guard [[Grip]], who was taking on a new deputy called [[Hartigen]], a deserter of the [[Kinshra|Black Knights]] seeking employment in Brimhaven. The Black Arms have waylaid Hartigen and stolen his identification papers. Volunteer to impersonate Hartigen. He will give you the [[Id papers]], which you will need to get into Scarface Pete's mansion, and tell you to introduce yourself to its guards.

Speak to [[Garv]], who is the guard patrolling along the southern wall of the large building on Brimhaven's western side. He will not believe you are Hartigen, stating that the Black Knight dressed differently. Equip a full set of [[black armour]]: full helm, platebody and platelegs. Garv will then allow you to go inside tells you to speak to Grip.

====Getting a Grip on the key====
[[File:Talking to Grip.png|thumb|250x250px|Grip explaining your duties.]]
Once inside, talk to [[Grip]]. He explains you will be working various guard duties, and that the important keys are in Grip's jacket. Ask him "So what do my duties involve?" and then "Anything I can do now?" and he will give you a [[Miscellaneous key]].

:'''Note:''' If you have already done the quest and have the Miscellaneous key in your bank, he will not give you a new one.

Grip won't allow you to enter the treasure room and you can't kill him without drawing attention to yourself. This means you will need an accomplice. Leave the building and trade the key to your [[Phoenix Gang]] partner.

====Handling the candlesticks====
[[File:Heroes'_Quest_-_Attacking_Grip.png|thumb|250x250px|A player attacking [[Grip]].]]
Back inside, head into the north-eastern room from the entrance. Wait for your partner to get to the room behind the eastern wall, behind the arrowslit; then, search the [[cupboard (Heroes' Quest)|cupboard]]. A [[pirate guard]] will say that Grip really doesn't like his drinks cabinet being touched, but open it anyway. Grip will then come into the room, telling you to get your hands off his drinks. Make sure the door is open. Grip can become stuck on the guards in the room, so you may need to wait or kill some guards to create space or else Grip may be blocked and leave the room. If this happens, just search the cupboard again. It's common for Grip to not come in the room all the way or retreat after being hit, so closing the door after he enters helps.

Your Phoenix Gang partner will then kill Grip through the slit from the hidden room. Once he dies, pick up [[Grip's keyring]]. 

Using the key, go to the treasure room (the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} room with coins on the floor next to the staircase in the north-west corner) and open the north chest in the first room to receive two candlesticks. '''Give one candlestick to your Phoenix Gang partner.'''

Go back to Varrock and talk to Katrine. She will give you the [[Thieves' armband]].

:'''Note:''' The door to the treasure room will not open and give you a message if you attempt to open it with Grip's keyring without having obtained a miscellaneous key at least once.
:'''Note:''' The chest containing Pete's candlesticks (position to the north) will be empty if you have a candlestick in your inventory or bank. If you have a traded one in the bank, you will need to discard it then come back to search this chest as you will not be able to turn in a traded candlestick to Katrine at any time.
:'''Note:''' Be sure to pick up the candlesticks yourself; otherwise, Katrine will say you weren't the one to retrieve the candlestick and you will have to go back to do it all over again.
:'''Note:''' Grip's Keyring is unique to the player you are doing the quest with. If you complete the quest and are retrieving candlesticks for a different player and still have Grip's Keyring, drop it and ask him for a new one.

=== Phoenix Gang member ===
{{Needed|A [[Ranged weapons|ranged weapon]] and [[ammo]] ([[brutal arrows]] will not work) or [[runes]] for [[Magic]]}}
[[File:Straven chathead.png|left]]
Go to [[Varrock]] and speak to [[Straven]] at the hideout. Enquire about becoming a master thief. He will explain that some eager gang members are trying to steal the valuable candlesticks of [[Scarface Pete]], the pirate leader of [[Brimhaven]]. He gives you the password ''gherkin'' to tell [[Alfonse the waiter|Alfonse]], a gang member posing as a waiter in [[The Shrimp and Parrot]] inn.

Get a [[bow]] and [[arrows]], or magic gear if using magic, before heading to [[Brimhaven]].

====The side entrance====
Go to the Shrimp and Parrot restaurant in Brimhaven. Once you are there, talk to Alfonse the waiter and ask about gherkins. He will wink and redirect you to [[Charlie the cook]] in the back room. Give him the password as well and tell him you are after Pete's candlesticks. Charlie the cook will tell you that the restaurant was set up as part of the heist. There is a secret wall-door that opens into [[Mr. Olbors]]'s garden that you are able to push to open. Across the garden is an old side entrance into the mansion that has since been blocked. However, the Phoenixes are unable to get hold of the key to that door. The pushable wall is in the kitchen, in the same room as where Charlie is. Beware of Mr. Olbors's [[guard dog]]s.

'''Get a [[miscellaneous key]] from your [[Black Arm Gang]] partner.''' Head into Olbors's garden and enter the mansion's eastern door. Once inside, use the miscellaneous key on the northern door. This brings you in a cramped room with an arrowslit into a room with a cupboard. Shoot through the hole in the wall at [[Grip]] and kill him with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]]. Your partner will have to lure him inside the room by rummaging through his drinks cabinet. It's common for Grip to not come in the room all the way or retreat out of the room after being hit. Have your Black Arm Gang partner close the door once he enters.  Grip will drop the key for your Black Arm Gang partner.

'''Your Black Arm Gang partner will get two [[Pete's candlestick|candlesticks]] and should trade you one of them.'''

:'''Note:''' You must actually kill Grip! If you don't, Straven will ''NOT'' accept your candlestick. Don't buy it or the key off other players as shortcut; you can't kill Grip alone.

Go back to Varrock and give the candlestick to Straven to get the [[Thieves' armband]].

===Entrana firebird feather===
{{Needed|[[Ice gloves]], or a [[pickaxe]] and combat equipment if you do not already own a pair|recommended=[[Energy potion|Energy]]/[[stamina potion]]s if obtaining [[ice gloves]]|skills={{SCP|Mining|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} if obtaining [[ice gloves]]}}

If you want, speak to a [[monk]] in the Entranan church about the firebird. He does not think they exist but redirects you to the head monk, who is more knowledgeable. The [[High Priest (Entrana)|High Priest]] tells you that the bird lives somewhere on Entrana, and that you will need some cold gloves to pick up its feather.

The [[firebird]] lives on the northern half of [[Entrana]]. It is very weak and easy to kill. However, its [[fire feather]] is too hot to pick up; you require something cold in order to do so. In order to pick up the [[fire feather]], you'll need [[ice gloves]]. They are dropped by the level 111 [[Ice Queen]] located underneath [[White Wolf Mountain]]. If you do not own ice gloves, see the section below.

Once you have a pair of ice gloves, bank your weapons and armour, but keep the gloves. Head to [[Entrana]] and kill the firebird near the [[Law Altar]]. Make sure to have the ice gloves equipped before picking up the feather.

You can also grab a fishing rod from the house beside the fishing platform on the south east corner of the island if you need a spare to use for making the oily fishing rod. 

====Ice Spy with my Little Eye====
[[File:Heroes'_Quest_-_Rockslide.png|thumb|250x250px|Compass pointing north; location of the rockslide to get into the lair.]]

If you do not already own [[Ice gloves]], go to White Wolf Mountain (east of [[Catherby]], west of [[Taverley]]), to the [[rock slide]] on the north side. It can be found just north-west of the [[gnome glider]]. Otherwise, enter the mountain at the southern entrance and walk or run north until you come to the rock slide.

Use a [[pickaxe]] on the rock slide ({{SCP|Mining|50}}) and go through it . Once you are through, you will be near level 57 [[ice warrior]]s and three ladders.

[[File:Heroes'_Quest_-_Ice_Queen's_Lair_route.png|thumb|220x220px|left|A map of the [[Ice Queen's Lair]].]]

{| class="wikitable lighttable"
!Steps
|-
|After the rock slide, head '''down''' the '''southernmost''' ladder
|-
| Go down the '''south-west''' tunnel and climb '''up''' the ladder at the end
|-
|Avoiding the [[Ice giant|ice giants]], climb down the '''easternmost''' ladder
|-
|Go '''north''' through the long tunnel, and climb '''up''' the ladder at the end
|-
|Climb '''down''' the ladder immediately next to it
|-
|Follow the tunnel '''north''' until it opens into a large room
|}
{{Clear}}
At the end of the room resides the [[Ice Queen]], kill her and she will drop the ice gloves. If you stand behind the throne, you can avoid the ice warriors and can still attack the Ice Queen if positioned right. Once you have the gloves, exit using the same route back or teleport out.

===Cooked lava eel===
{{Needed|A [[fishing rod]], [[fishing bait]], [[harralander potion (unf)]] (or a [[harralander]] and [[vial of water]]), other items depending on chosen location (see below)|skills={{SCP|Herblore|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to make [[blamish oil]], {{SCP|Fishing|53}} {{Boostable|yes}} to catch a [[raw lava eel]], and {{SCP|Cooking|53}} {{Boostable|yes}} to cook it}}
[[File:Heroes' Quest Gerrant.png|thumb|250px|Speaking to the fishing expert about catching a lava eel.]]
Go to [[Port Sarim]] and talk to [[Gerrant]] at the [[fishing shop]]. He will tell you that catching a lava eel requires a lava-proof fishing line, which can be created by coating an ordinary [[fishing rod]] with [[blamish oil]]. Gerrant will give you a free bottle of [[blamish snail slime]], which is added to a [[harralander potion (unf)]] to make the blamish oil. Buy a fishing rod and some bait from him if you haven't got any yet.

After making the blamish oil, right-click on it to use it on a normal [[fishing rod]] to get an [[oily fishing rod]].

There are '''four possible locations''' where you can catch [[Raw lava eel|lava eels]]:
* [[Taverley Dungeon]] is a safe option, but requires the player to to take a long and winding path if they do not have at least level 70 [[Agility]] to use the shortcut.
* The [[Lava Maze]] (level 40-45 [[Wilderness]]) may alternatively be chosen as catching a lava eel there is a hard [[Wilderness Diary]] task. As with all Wilderness activities, there is a risk of being killed by other players.
* The [[Charred Dungeon]] requires level 60 [[Sailing]] to access. The route is shorter and more straightforward than Taverley Dungeon, but players will need to spend time sailing there.
* The [[Wyrmscraig Cavern]] requires level 62 Sailing and the completion of [[Fallen From Grace]] to access. A [[slayer ring]] will take the player directly to the caverns, and may be the fastest option for players that have already completed the quest.

====Taverley Dungeon====
{{Needed|[[Dusty key]] (can be obtained in the dungeon) or {{SCP|Agility|70}}|recommended=[[Dragonfire]] protection such as an [[anti-dragon shield]], [[stamina potion|stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s, [[food]] or prayer points for [[Protect from Melee]] if low-levelled}}
[[File:Heroes'_Quest_-_Taverley_Dungeon_route.png|thumb|250px|Routes to the lava eels and dusty key.]]
Make your way to [[Taverley]] and enter the dungeon to the south of the town. Some options include the [[balloon transport system]], [[Falador Teleport]] and going west over the {{SCP|Agility|5}} [[shortcut]], or using [[Teleport to House]] if it is in Taverley.

'''If you have 70 Agility''' (which can be boosted), enter the pipe after putting on your dragonfire protection and run south. The [[fishing spot]] is near some [[baby blue dragon]]s, which generally do not attack you from the position.

'''If you don't have 70 Agility''', follow the magenta path on the image to the right. Walk through the dungeon and use the [[dusty key]] on the door between the [[lesser demon]]s and [[blue dragon]]s. If you have 63 Agility, you can save a bit of time by squeezing through loose railings to go straight to the lesser demon area.

If you don't have the dusty key, go past the bridge, continue south-west past the [[hill giant]]s, and you will enter the [[Black Knights' Base]]. Go to the east into a jail, kill the [[jailer]] and then pick up his key. Use it on the jail cell holding [[Velrak the explorer]]. Ask him if there are any good places to explore to get the dusty key. Head back north past the hill giants and follow the magenta path to the fishing spot. Use the key on the door between the lesser demons and blue dragons. The fishing spot is near some baby blue dragons; from here, catch a lava eel.

====Islands====
{{Needed|A [[boat]]|skills={{SCP|Sailing|60}} {{Boostable|no}} or {{SCP|Sailing|62}} {{Boostable|no}}|recommended=[[Dragonfire]] protection such as an [[anti-dragon shield]], [[stamina potion|stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s, [[food]] or prayer points for [[Protect from Melee]] if low-levelled}}
There are two [[Sailing]] islands that have [[fishing spot (lava eel)|lava eel fishing spots]]. Going to these locations may be ideal for those who don't have 70 [[Agility]] and don't want to spend time getting the dusty key, or don't want to risk entering the Wilderness. 

[[Charred Island]], which requires a Sailing level of 60, has a fishing spot in the [[Charred Dungeon]]. There is no teleport to this island, so you must sail there. To reach the fishing spot, you must run past dragons, nechryael, and lava strykewyrms, so bringing [[dragonfire]] protection and some food is recommended.

[[Wyrmscraig]], which requires a Sailing level of 62, has a fishing spot in the [[Wyrmscraig Cavern]]. After completing the quest [[Fallen From Grace]], you can quickly teleport to the cavern by using a [[slayer ring]], or to the island itself with a [[necklace of passage]]. Reaching the fishing spot only requires briefly running past some unaggressive [[wyrm]]s, making it safer than navigating the Charred Dungeon.

====Lava Maze====
{{Needed|A [[knife]] or a [[slash weapon]] (all tiers of [[Wilderness sword]] will always succeed)|recommended=Burning amulet}}
{{Map|name=Lava Maze|3070,3853|zoom=1|align=right|height=180|width=280|caption=A map of the Lava Maze.}}

'''{{Colour|Red|Warning}}:''' The [[Lava Maze]] is located in level 40-45 [[Wilderness]], meaning that many [[player killer]]s will be within the level range to attack you. Do not bring any items you are not willing to lose.

There are several methods to get to the Lava Maze:
*Teleporting there directly using the [[burning amulet]]. This is the quickest way.
*Casting the [[Ghorrock Teleport]] spell (or [[Ghorrock teleport|tablet]]) in the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook. This requires completing the quest [[Desert Treasure I]].
*Take the [[Wilderness Obelisk]]s to the destination at level 35 or level 44 Wilderness. This may take several attempts. The obelisks can be quickly accessed by taking the [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Ferox Enclave]].
** Beware of the [[Chaos Fanatic]] if arriving from the Ghorrock Teleport of level 44 Wilderness Obelisk.
*Take a waka canoe from [[Edgeville]] or any other [[Canoe Station#River Lum|River Lum Canoe Station]] to the [[Wilderness Pond]]. This requires 57 [[Woodcutting]]. Then walk west to arrive near the entrance.

Upon arriving at the entrance, use your knife or slash weapon to cut the web and proceed through the maze until you see the fishing icon on your minimap. The fishing spot is relatively near the entrance.

If you die with your oily fishing rod, you will probably lose it and have to make a new one. If Gerrant does not give you another bottle of [[blamish snail slime]]<!--requires testing-->, you can also get it by killing a [[Myre blamish snail]] and grinding its meat with a [[pestle and mortar]] with an empty [[sample bottle]] in your inventory. The sample bottle can be obtained from [[Fidelio]] in the [[Canifis General Store]].

[[File:Catching a lava eel.png|thumb|220px|Fishing in the lava.]]

Once you catch a [[raw lava eel]] ({{SCP|Fishing|53}}), cook it over a [[fire]] or a [[range]] ({{SCP|Cooking|53}}).

:'''Note:''' Lava eels do not burn when cooked (or, indeed, when swimming in lava). Do not worry about obtaining multiple eels if you are worried about burning one.

===Quest end===
Go back to the [[Heroes' Guild]], talk to [[Achietties]] outside and give her the three collected items.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===The crest===
{{Map|x=3281|y=3404|r=4|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The quest's starting point|mtype=square}}

To begin, talk with [[Dimintheis]], who lives in south-eastern [[Varrock]], within the fenced off area, in the house just above the [[Fancy Clothes Store|clothes shop]]. Tell him you are a bold adventurer and he will propose an adventure for you; he needs his family crest returned. Ask him where the crest is, and he will explain his three sons took it with them when they rode out to battle many years ago. He hadn't heard from them since, until he recently learned that his son [[Caleb]] was working as a chef beyond the [[White Wolf Mountain]], in [[Catherby]].

===Caleb===
{{Needed|[[Shrimps]], [[bass]], [[salmon]], [[tuna]] and a [[swordfish]] (all cooked).}}

Head to [[Catherby]], where Caleb can be found either inside the building with the sink to the south of the [[Farming shop]], or wandering outside of it. Talk to him and ask if he is Caleb Fitzharmon, and he will tell you he has a 'bit' of the crest. Ask him what happened to the rest of it, and he will explain that he and his brothers broke the crest into three [[Crest part|parts]] after a disagreement about who would become heir to their fathers' lands, and each of them ended up with a piece. Ask if you can have his bit of the crest, and he will agree to give you his piece provided you bring him ingredients for his fish salad. Agree to bring him the ingredients.

:'''Note''': You must ask him what happened to the rest of the crest, or you will be unable to collect the other parts.

Bring him the [[shrimp]], [[salmon]], [[tuna]], [[bass]], and [[swordfish]] (all cooked) and he will give you his piece of the crest.

===Avan===
{{Needed|[[necklace mould]], [[ring mould]], any [[pickaxe]], 2 [[Ruby|cut rubies]]|recommended=Food and armour, fast travel method to Dwarven Mine, Witchaven and Al Kharid.|skills={{SCP|Mining|40}} {{Boostable|yes}} to mine [[perfect gold ore]], {{SCP|Smithing|40}} {{Boostable|yes}} to smelt [[perfect gold bar]], {{SCP|Crafting|40}} {{Boostable|yes}} to craft the [['perfect' necklace]] and [['perfect' ring]]}}

Caleb mentioned that the last he heard from his brother Avan, he was searching for treasure in the desert, and that you might want to ask the traders there about him.

Head to the [[gem trader]] in the north of [[Al Kharid]], found next to the [[gnome glider]] just south of the gate to [[Lumbridge]]. Ask him about Avan Fitzharmon, and he will remember that the man was searching for 'perfect gold'. The gem trader told him to search the sand dunes where [[gold rocks]] can be found. Head to the northern [[Al Kharid Mine]], and a man can be found wandering around just at the entrance to the pit with a yellow [[cape]] on. This is, indeed, [[Avan]], as he'll tell you when you ask him. He's not giving up his piece of the crest though unless you can help him win the affection of a certain lady by getting him a [['perfect' ring|ring]] and [['perfect' necklace|necklace]] made out of perfect gold. Unfortunately, the stuff there in the desert isn't nearly good enough. He'll tell you a [[dwarf]] named [[Boot]] might know something about where to find the gold.

:'''Note:''' The player must speak to Boot before being able to give the jewellery to Avan, even though it is possible to mine and smith perfect jewellery without speaking to him.

{{Map|mapID=6|2984,9810|width=250|height=250|align=right|r=6|mtype=square|caption=[[Boot]] is located towards the far west end of [[Dwarven Mine]].}}

Head to the [[Dwarven Mines]], located just west of the [[Edgeville Monastery]]. Climb down the trapdoor behind the eastern building to enter the mines. Boot can be found south-west from this northern entrance, wandering by the two rock columns - see the map to the right. Tell him you are in search of very high quality gold, and he will direct you to east of [[Ardougne]], underground somewhere. The location you need to visit is the [[Witchaven Shrine|Witchaven Dungeon]] in [[Witchaven]].

:'''Note''': You will need to pass by level 28 [[hobgoblins]], level 53 [[ogres]], and level 122 [[hellhounds]] in this dungeon, though you do not need to kill any of them. The hobgoblins will attack you immediately after entering the dungeon if below 57 [[Combat Level]], and you will need to solve a puzzle while being attacked by ogres (if below 107 combat level). [[Protect from Melee]] will negate all damage, as the monsters only use melee.

Enter the dungeon and head north east along the path. To the north and south are two rooms with [[lever (Family Crest)|lever]]s in and outside of them. You'll have to complete a lever puzzle here to unlock the eastern area which contains the gold rocks and hellhounds:

{{Checklist|
*Go to the northern room and pull the outside lever up.
*Head into the southern room using the eastern door, pull the lever up, then exit via the '''western''' door.
*Go to the northern room and pull the outside lever down, then enter and pull the inner lever up.
*Leave the room and pull the outside lever up again.
*Go back to the southern room through the '''western''' door and pull the lever down, then exit via the '''eastern''' door.
*The hellhound room should now be unlocked.
}}

'''Note''': Once unlocked, you do not need to do the puzzle again to re-enter.

Enter the hellhound room to the east and mine at least two [['perfect' gold ore]] from the gold rocks ({{SCP|Mining|40}}). The hellhounds have a short aggression range - try and zigzag past them to find an open rock to mine. If you draw aggression before you are done mining, there is a [[safespot]] you can use to hide in behind the rock column directly south of the entrance - you can then world hop to lose aggression and try again. Low levelled players may also consider waiting 10 minutes in this safespot, after which the hellhounds will not attack you while mining the southern rocks. The rocks will take some time to respawn, so once you have mined one rock, use another or world hop to reset the rock.

[[File:Family Crest - Witchaven Dungeon levers.png|thumb|The sequence of operating the levers to get perfect gold.]]

Once you have your two 'perfect' gold ore, head to any [[furnace]] with the ore, your [[rubies]], your [[ring mould]], and your [[necklace mould]]. You may consider using the one in [[Al Kharid]], as you will be returning to Avan in the Al Kharid mine afterwards. Smelt the ore into [['perfect' gold bar]]s ({{SCP|Smithing|40}}), then smelt a bar each into a ruby necklace and ruby ring respectively ({{SCP|Crafting|40}}, {{SCP|Smithing|40}}), which will make the [['perfect' ring]] and [['perfect' necklace]] ('''DO NOT SELECT the GOLD necklace and ring!''').

Return to Avan in the Al Kharid Mine, and he will take your jewellery and give you the second piece of the crest in return. He will then tell you how to find the final brother Johnathon.

===Johnathon===
{{Needed|An [[antipoison]] potion, [[runes]] to cast the four Blast spells, combat equipment for the battle with [[Chronozon]].|recommended=Fast travel method to the Jolly Boar Inn, Edgeville and Varrock|skills={{SCP|Magic|59}} {{Boostable|yes}} to cast [[Fire Blast]]}}
[[File:Edgeville Dungeon map.png|thumb|upright|Edgeville Dungeon]]
The last brother is holed up on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the Jolly Boar Inn north-east of [[Varrock]] near the edge of the [[Wilderness]]. Bring your [[Antipoison|antipoison potion]], and head up to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} where he is huddled in the north western room. Talk to him and he will be delirious - he has been bitten by a [[Poison spider|poisonous spider]]. Once he has finished speaking, use the antipoison on him (he'll take the entire potion, but you may bring a lower dosed potion) and he'll be very grateful to be cured.

Johnathon will tell you that he lost the crest while attempting to kill a powerful demon named [[Chronozon]]. If you want it back, you'll have to kill the demon yourself. Johnathon explains that to defeat the demon, you will need to first hit him once with each of the four elemental spells of death.

[[Chronozon]] can be found in the [[Edgeville Dungeon]], by the [[poison spiders]] near the [[Earth obelisk]].

:'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' You will be heading into the [[Wilderness]], where other players may kill you. Only take items you are willing to lose to [[player killers]], and consider using a low population world.

[[File:Chronozon safespot.png|thumb|Chronozon safespot.]]

To defeat Chronozon, you will need to cast [[Wind Blast]], [[Water Blast]], [[Earth Blast]], and [[Fire Blast]] and '''successfully hit him''' once with each (in any order). {{mes|Chronozon weakens....}} will appear in the chat after each individual hit from a blast spell. You do not need to kill him using Magic after he has been weakened, though he has no Magic defence and is weak to [[Water spells]].

Along with enough runes to cast each blast spell several times, bring food, combat equipment and a [[poison cure]] for the poison spiders near Chronozon. Head to [[Edgeville]] and enter the dungeon through the trapdoor in the south eastern corner of the building south of the bank. Head north, then east through the gate past the skeletons, then north through the gate with thugs on the other side. Continue north past the thugs, west past the red spiders and black demons, then south to the [[Obelisk of Earth]].

There is a [[safespot]] one square in front of the eastern standing torch for Magic and Ranged. If you draw aggression of the poison spiders, stand behind the stalagmite to avoid it, then hop worlds. Weaken him with each blast spell, then kill him with any combat style.

:'''Note''': If you take too long to kill him, his weakness will wear off and you'll have to weaken him again.

{{bug|The [[Twinflame staff]]'s double cast feature does not kill him as expected.}}

Chronozon will drop the final crest piece on death, pick it up.

===The crest reassembled===
Now that you have all three crest pieces, put them together to make the [[family crest (item)|Family Crest]] and then make your way back to [[Varrock]]. Give the crest to [[Dimintheis]] who will be very, very pleased to have it back.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Tip:''' You may choose to talk to Dimintheis again to start the [[Family Pest]] miniquest before imbuing one of the gauntlets, as you will additionally have the chat option to progress the miniquest.

==Walkthrough==
===Dwarves can't fish!===
{{Map|x=2842|y=3486|x:2876,y:3483,desc:[[Austri]]|x:2821,y:3487,desc:[[Vestri]]|plane=0|mapID=0|zoom=1|height=220|width=220|align=right|mtype=pin|caption=This quest can be started from either side of the White Wolf Mountain.}}
{{Needed|recommended=Fast travel method to McGrubor's Wood and Hemenster for the subsequent sections}}
[[File:Austri chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
To start this quest, head to either the dwarf [[Austri]] east of [[White Wolf Mountain]] or the dwarf [[Vestri]] west of the mountain, at the points shown on the map.

:'''Tip:''' The western quest start point is closer to the next part of the quest, so it is recommended if not planning to use fast travel.

Talk with either dwarf, and use the following dialogue options. {{Chat option|1I was wondering what was down those stairs?|2Why not?|3If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it.|1Well, let's be friends!|1And how am I meant to do that?}} Ask what is down the stairs, and he will say you can't use them. Ask why not, and he will ask you how you would like it if he took a shortcut through your home. Tell him if he was your friend you wouldn't mind, and he will say he doesn't know you. Ask to be friends; he wants you to earn his trust first. Ask how you are meant to do that, and he will mention that the dwarves are after a gold artefact, the first prize at the [[Hemenster]] fishing contest. He will give you a [[fishing pass]] to enter in the competition. You must win the competition before the dwarves will allow you to use the shortcut.

===Help from the champion===
{{Needed|A [[spade]]|recommended=armour and food for low level players}}
[[File:Fishing Contest - red vine.png|thumb|Checking the vine.|220px]]
[[File:Grandpa Jack chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
If you were to head to the contest, [[Grandpa Jack]] the previous champion would give you advice on how to win; you can skip this however, and gather the required items without needing to speak to him.

If you don't already have [[garlic]], pick up a piece off the table in the house south-west of the [[bank]] in [[Seers' Village]].

With your [[spade]], head to [[McGrubor's Wood]] west of [[Seers' Village]], also accessible by the [[Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|als}} inside (using the ring will also complete a medium [[Kandarin Diary]] task). If entering from outside, the southern gate is locked and you must squeeze through the railing on the northern side. Beware of aggressive level 44 [[guard dog]]s.

Just west of the fairy ring, you will find a red vine. Check the red vine and collect at least 2 [[red vine worms]].

===Winning the trophy===
{{Needed|A [[fishing pass]], [[fishing rod]], [[garlic]], 5 [[coins]] (10 if no rod), and 1 [[red vine worm]]}}
[[File:Sinister Stranger chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
Head to [[Hemenster]], located by the Ranging Guild. If you didn't bring a fishing rod, buy one for 5 [[coins]] from [[Grandpa Jack]] in the house slightly north-east of the town.

Find [[Morris]] at the gate to [[Hemenster]] and show him your [[fishing pass]] and he will let you in.

Put the [[garlic]] into the third pipe from the gate on the south wall of the north [[Hemenster]] building.

Pay [[Bonzo]] the contest fee to start the contest (5 coins). The [[Sinister Stranger]] will complain about a horrible smell and you will change places with him.

[[File:Fishing Contest - Fishing the giant carp.png|thumb|220px|Fishing next to the pipes.]]
Fish at the spot by the pipes using the [[red vine worm]]s. You will catch a [[raw giant carp|giant carp]], a unique type of fish that you can't catch normally, and that will be the prize winning fish.

Speak to [[Bonzo]] again and hand over the [[raw giant carp|giant carp]]. You will be announced the winner of the Fishing Competition.

After winning the contest and obtaining your [[Fishing trophy|trophy]], head back to the quest starting point on either side of the mountain and give the dwarf your trophy.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===King Arthur and the Holy Grail===
[[File:King Arthur chathead.png|left]]
Speak to [[King Arthur]] in [[Camelot]], who mentions he is sending out knights on an important quest. Ask him about it, and he will say they have recently learned the [[holy grail (item)|holy grail]] has passed into [[Gielinor]]. He wants you to speak to [[Merlin]] who may know more about where to find it. 

[[Merlin]] can be found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Camelot Castle]], north-west of King Arthur up the staircase in the south-east room ('''not''' the south-east tower where you went up the ladder to rescue Merlin in the 'Merlin's Crystal' quest). Merlin will appear once you enter the south-east room. Merlin will suggest that the grail is likely to reside in a holy place like [[Entrana]], and that [[Sir Galahad]] previously quested for the grail and may know more.
{{Clear|left}}

===The old crone's warning===
{{Needed|recommended=Fast travel to Galahad, Draynor Manor, and then Brimhaven for future sections. You will need your combat equipment before the Brimhaven step.}}
[[File:Crone chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Before speaking to Galahad, you must first visit Entrana. Head to [[Port Sarim]] and travel with the [[Monks of Entrana]], depositing any [[weapons]] or [[armour]] via the nearby bank deposit box, as the monks will not allow them on the island.

Speak to the [[High Priest (Entrana)|high priest]] of the church, who says that the grail passed through the island but is no longer here. A [[Crone|strange old crone]] will appear and say that a [[Fisher King]] is in trouble. To help him you must find where the six [[Mysterious statue|stone heads]] around the world point to and blow a [[magic whistle]] there, in order to enter his realm.
{{Clear|left}}

===Galahad's holy table napkin===
[[File:Galahad chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Map|name=Galahad|x=2613|y=3477|r=4|mtype=square|caption=[[Galahad]]'s house west of [[McGrubor's Wood]]s and [[Camelot]].|width=220|height=220|align=right}}
Head to [[Galahad]], found in a house west of [[McGrubor's Wood]]. Tell him you're looking for an item from the [[Fisher Realm]], and he will reluctantly give you a [[holy table napkin]], a souvenir he took from the Fisher Realm.

'''Note:''' To complete a task in the easy [[Kandarin Diary]], ask him if he ever gets lonely, and he will give you a cup of tea.

With your napkin, head to the top floor of [[Draynor Manor]] and into the room south of [[Professor Oddenstein]]. You will see a pair of magic whistles on the table. Pick up '''both''', one will be taken from you later. [[Fairy rings|Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|BJR}} will become accessible later in the quest - if you plan to use it, you will only need one, though taking multiple is still useful in case of mistakes. More than two can be obtained by dropping the whistles outside the room, entering it again, grabbing the two new whistles that spawn, and picking the dropped ones back up.

'''Note''': The whistles have a despawn timer, but will respawn upon re-entering the room.
{{Clear|left}}

===Passing into the Fisher Realm===
[[File:Magic whistle detail.png|left|60px]]
{{Needed|[[Excalibur]], [[magic whistle]], and combat equipment|recommended=[[food]], [[anti-poison]] if under level 41 [[Combat]], fast travel method to Camelot and Goblin Village for future sections, pickaxe for an easy Karamja Diary task ({{SCP|Mining|40}})|skills={{SCP|Attack|20}} {{Boostable|no}} to wield [[Excalibur]]}}{{Map|2742,3234|r=3|mtype=square|caption=The location to blow the magic whistle.|width=220|height=220|align=right}}
Head to [[Brimhaven]], ensuring you have your combat equipment with you. Go west of the town and then up the northern peninsula to the [[North Brimhaven mine|goldmine]], avoiding the [[poisonous]] [[scorpions]] if below [[Combat level]] 41. Look for a guard tower north of where the [[gold rocks]] are.

'''Note:''' To complete an easy [[Karamja Diary]] task, take the rope swing to the western island (with the Giants) and back.

'''Note:''' If you brought a pickaxe, you can complete an easy [[Karamja Diary]] task by mining a piece of gold here with {{SCP|Mining|40}}.

Go under the tower and blow one of the magic whistles, and you will be teleported to the [[Fisher King's Realm]].

===Black Knight Titan===
[[File:Black Knight Titan chathead.png|left|80px|frameless]]
[[File:Holy Grail - Fighting the Black Knight Titan.png|thumb|right|220px|Fighting the [[Black Knight Titan]].]]
The [[Black Knight Titan]] guards the bridge ahead, and you must defeat him before you may continue. You may deal damage to him with other weapons but the '''killing blow must be dealt with [[Excalibur]]''', otherwise he will heal to full health. Using [[melee]] to defeat him is '''highly recommended''', as he has +1000 defence against [[Magic]] and [[Ranged]].

As the Black Knight Titan will not move, it is extremely easy to defeat him through [[flinching]], by hitting him and moving back one square immediately. Unlike most monsters, the player does not have to wait for the Black Knight Titan's health bar to disappear before attacking him again; they can immediately walk back to attack him after moving back one square. If you do take damage, his max hit is up to 15, so beware. Using a [[halberd]] will allow you to defeat him with [[melee]] from range with no chance of taking damage. '''Remember to switch back to Excalibur''' at around 10% hitpoints remaining to avoid accidentally healing him to full. At low levels the knight may take 15 minutes or more to kill due to its 142 hitpoints and high melee defence.

After killing the titan, cross the bridge and then head south along the river until you find a [[Fisherman (Holy Grail)|fisherman]]. Ask him how to get inside the castle, and he will tell you to ring the bell.

Head to [[Fisher Realm#Grail Castle|the castle]] located south-west from the fisherman where you will find a [[grail bell]] on the ground in front of the entrance. Ring it and a [[Grail Maiden]] will invite you inside.

Go up the western staircase and speak to the [[Fisher King]]. Tell him you seek the grail, and he will reply that legend has it a questing knight will restore the Fisher Realm to its former glory and then claim the grail as their prize. Tell the Fisher King he doesn't look well, and he will tell you he fears his life is running short; he wants you to find his son [[Percival]], who is actually a Knight of the Round Table, and bring him to the castle.

{{Color|Red|Warning:}} Complete both dialogues before leaving, or you may have to return and kill the titan again!

Blow your whistle again to be teleported out, or teleport out through other means and return to Camelot.

===Finding Percival===
[[File:Holy Grail - Talking to Sir Percival.png|thumb|right|220px|Finding [[Sir Percival]].]]
{{Needed|Both [[magic whistle]]s, [[magic gold feather]]|recommended=Fast travel to the Fisher Realm and then Camelot, bring antipoison if not using fairy rings and under combat level 41}}
[[File:Sir Percival chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Speak to [[King Arthur]], who will recall [[Percival]] riding off on a quest to recover the golden boots of Arkaneeses a few months back. He will give you a [[magic gold feather]] which is said to point towards the location of the boots.

Blow on the feather, and it will guide you towards [[Goblin Village]], located north of [[Falador]]. Once at the Goblin Village, Open the [[Sacks (Holy Grail)|sacks]] in the east house (do not just prod), and you will find Sir Percival ('''you must have the feather in your inventory'''). Tell him that his father wishes to see him. Percival doesn't know how to get to the castle; if you have a magic whistle in your inventory, you will automatically give it to him when the conversation ends.

[[File:Holy Grail - Taking the Holy grail.png|thumb|left|220px|Take the [[Holy grail (item)|Holy grail]].]]

===Retrieving the Holy Grail===
Head back to the Fisher King's Realm like before (you don't need to fight the [[Black Knight Titan]] this time). You may now also teleport there using [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|BJR}}. Return to where the [[Fisher King]] previously was to find that Percival has become the new king.

Head back downstairs, go up the staircase on the east end of the castle, and continue up the ladder. Take the [[Holy grail (item)|holy grail]].

Return to King Arthur in Camelot and the player will inform him that the grail has been retrieved.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
{{Clear}}

==Walkthrough==
===Kidnapping===
{{Needed|recommended=Combat equipment, preferably Ranged or Magic to utilise safespots}}
{{Map|2566,3199|align=left|r=5|height=240|width=240|mtype=square|caption=Location of quest start.}}
[[File:Lady Servil chathead.png|left]]
Head just south-west of the [[Ardougne Monastery]] and talk to [[Lady Servil]] by the north-east corner of the [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]] maze. She will explain that her family has been kidnapped by [[General Khazard]] and his group of mercenaries and forced to fight in their arena. The player will agree to help rescue them.

{{Map|2613,3190|mtype=pin|align=right|height=220|width=220|caption=The location of the chest containing the [[Khazard armour|armour]].}}
[[File:Fight Arena - Khazard armour chest.png|thumb|220px|The chest containing the [[Khazard armour|armour]].]]
Head east to a group of buildings located south of the [[Ardougne Monastery]]. In the most north-eastern house, search the chest to obtain [[Khazard armour]]. Equip both pieces and head south to the prison, which forms the south and east boundaries of the arena.

'''Note:''' Multiple sets of armour may be obtained using the [[drop trick]].

The guards will only let you into the prison wearing the Khazard armour. Once inside, do not remove it, or the guards will not speak to you. You can wear anything in any of the other slots.

===Staging a breakout===
{{Needed|5 coins}}
[[File:Khazard Guard chathead.png|left]]
[[Sammy Servil]] (the boy in the purple shirt) is located in the northernmost cell of the east wing of the prison. Ask him where the [[Khazard cell keys|cell keys]] are, and he will explain the Head Guard has them.

Head to the south-eastern corner of the jail and talk to the Head Guard by the staircase. He will mention his cravings for [[Khali brew]] and let it slip that last time he had too many, he fell asleep on the job.

Head to the bar found west of the western entrance to the jail, and purchase [[Khali brew]] from the [[Khazard barman]] for five [[coins]]. '''If there is no option to, you must finish the dialogue with the head guard.'''

Return to the head guard and give him the brew, and he will quickly get drunk, handing the player the keys when asked.

Ensure you have your [[combat]] [[equipment]] and prepare for three enemies you must fight in a row (all [[safespottable]]).

Use the keys on Sammy's prison door to free him and a cutscene will begin, in which Sammy enters the main arena in search of his father [[Justin Servil|Justin]], who is being attacked by a [[Khazard ogre]].

===The fights===
{{Instance}}

'''Note''': The [[dwarven multicannon]] cannot be set up in the arena.

'''Note:''' Throughout the fights, you may teleport out if you run into trouble. Speaking to the [[Khazard Guard]] by the door of the prison will take you back into the arena.

[[File:General Khazard chathead.png|left]]
You must kill the level 63 [[Khazard Ogre]] attacking Sammy's father. There is a very easy [[safespot]]
behind a nearby skeleton, whereby you may use [[Magic]], [[Ranged]] or a [[halberd]] for an easy fight. All of the following enemies use melee, so you can alternately use [[Protect from Melee]]. 

'''Note''': If a fight sequence does not initiate, speak to Justin in order to continue, '''but note that if the ogre has already spawned, a second one will appear if you talk to Justin.'''

After defeating the ogre, [[General Khazard]] will appear and order his guards to lock you away after suggesting that if you fight in his arena, he might let the Servils go. 

Talk to your cellmate [[Hengrad]], and after a brief conversation the guard will bring you back to the arena.

The second fight is with a level 44 non poisonous [[Khazard scorpion]]. Note that it will reach you quickly, so you should immediately run to the same safespot or activate [[Protect from Melee]].

[[File:Fight Arena - Fighting General Khazard.png|thumb|right|Fighting [[General Khazard]] with [[Magic]] using the [[safespot]].]]
After defeating the scorpion, Khazard will release [[Bouncer]] the level 137 hellhound. You will need high healing food if not using the safespot or [[Protect from Melee]] at a low level, but otherwise the strategy is the same.

After killing the hellhound, a level 142 [[General Khazard]] will vow to make you pay for killing his puppy, and then attack you. '''This fight is optional''', and the quest progresses the same if you leave now via the door (use its Quick-escape option to avoid needing to confirm you wish to leave). The same strategies as before are effective against the general.

Return to [[Lady Servil]] and she will tell you that her son and husband are safe and recovering at home.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Hazeel thieves===
[[File:Ceril Carnillean chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Head to the house in the south-western corner of [[East Ardougne]] and speak to [[Ceril Carnillean]], who will start ranting about thieving cultists. Ask him what's wrong, and he'll explain that some cultists have stolen a suit of armour. You will offer to help get the armour back, and Ceril will point you in the direction of a cave to the south of the city. Head east of the [[Clock Tower (building)|clock tower]], and enter the cave.
{{Clear|left}}

===Picking a side===
[[File:Clivet chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
At this stage you will have a choice between two sides in this quest: helping Ceril get his family armour back and foiling the plan to revive [[Hazeel]], or helping Hazeel's followers murder a Carnillean and resurrect their master.

The reward is almost the same for either side. Siding with Ceril rewards 5 additional [[coins]], and gives you the option to obtain [[Carnillean armour]], a weak armour with lower defensive bonuses than an [[iron platebody]]. This side is quicker, but requires killing [[Alomone]], which is not recommended for very low-level players.  Siding with Hazeel will reward the [[Hazeel's mark]], which is a purely cosmetic reward. 

Rewards may only be obtained during or upon completion of the quest, and can '''never''' be reclaimed afterward. Your choice will also have a minor effect on the events of the quest [[Secrets of the North]]. If siding with Ceril, read the following section; if siding with Hazeel, [[Hazeel Cult#Siding with Hazeel|click here to skip to the section below]].

===Siding with Ceril===
{{Map:Hazeel Cult}}
{{Needed|Weapon, armour and food}}
[[File:Butler Jones chathead.png|left|frameless]]
If you've chosen to side with Ceril, talk to [[Clivet]] in the cave to learn about [[Hazeel]], an ancient and powerful follower of Zamorak who was killed by an ancestor of Ceril. He will ask for your help in reviving Hazeel. '''Refuse'''.

Clivet will sail away on a raft, saying that you'll never be able to find him. Go back upstairs, find the [[sewer valve]]s, and turn them in the proper direction.
{{Clear|left}}
{{Checklist|
*'''Valve 1''' - North of the cave. Turn it <u>'''left'''</u>.
*'''Valve 2''' - West of Valve 1, southern end of the bridge by the Carnilleans' house. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 3''' - North-east of Valve 2, across the bridge. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 4''' - Other side of the river from Valve 3; cross the bridge again and head east towards the zoo's penguin cage. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 5''' - South-east of Valve 4, past the monk. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
}}
After you've turned all five, go back into the cave. Board the raft, then head to the southernmost room and talk to [[Alomone]]. He will let it slip that Ceril's butler is part of the cult, before attacking you. Kill him, then open the chest in the room to get the [[Carnillean armour]].

'''Note''': You can use the [[drop trick]] if you want your own armour.

Board the raft again in order to return to the sewer entrance. Back at the Carnilleans' house, talk to [[Ceril Carnillean]], who will take the armour from you and give you 5 coins. After the player accuses the butler, he will refuse to believe you.

'''You'll see a quest reward screen, but you haven't received the real reward yet!'''

{{Listen|filename=Oh Dear!.ogg|align=right|title=[[Oh Dear!|Congratulations! Quest complete!]]|desc=Or not...}}
[[File:Hazeel Cult partial completion reward scroll.png|frame|centre|The first (fake) "reward". Continue the next step to claim your real reward.]]

Search the [[cupboard (Hazeel Cult)|cupboard]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} and you will find the Mark of Hazeel and a bottle of poison. Show these to Ceril. He will fire Butler Jones and give you the ''real'' quest reward.

===Siding with Hazeel===
{{Map:Hazeel Cult}}
[[File:Hazeel chathead.png|left|frameless]]
If you've chosen to side with [[Hazeel]], make sure you have a free inventory slot and then talk to [[Clivet]] to learn about [[Hazeel]]. He will explain that Hazeel is an ancient and powerful follower of Zamorak who was killed by an ancestor of Ceril. He will ask for your help in reviving Hazeel. '''Accept.'''

He wants you to prove your loyalty by killing Ceril. Ask him how, and he will give you some poison and instruct you to pour it in Ceril's food.

Head to the basement of Ceril's house, and use the bottle of poison on the range. Then, go upstairs and talk to Ceril Carnillean to learn that you've accidentally killed Scruffy the family dog instead; his son gave the meal to him.

Talk to Clivet again, and he will have heard about the accident, but takes it as proof of your loyalty regardless.  He'll give you [[Hazeel's mark]], then tell you to meet with their leader [[Alomone]] in their hideout. To get to the hideout, you need to find five [[Sewer valve]]s and turn them the proper direction.
{{Checklist|
*'''Valve 1''' - North of the cave. Turn it <u>'''left'''</u>.
*'''Valve 2''' - West of Valve 1, southern end of the bridge by the Carnilleans' house. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 3''' - North-east of Valve 2, across the bridge. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 4''' - Other side of the river from Valve 3; cross the bridge again and head east towards the zoo's penguin cage. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 5''' - South-east of Valve 4, past the monk. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
}}
[[File:Hazeel Cult - Hazeel revived.gif|thumb|200px|Hazeel emerges from his coffin.]]

Go back to the cave and board the raft. Once you're in the main hideout, talk to [[Alomone]]. He wants you to help the Carnillean's butler, an undercover cultist, retrieve a [[Hazeel scroll| magical scroll of restoration]] that is hidden in the Carnilleans' house.

Talk to [[Butler Jones]] in the house, who believes the scroll is hidden where even the family won't find it. Search the [[crate (Hazeel Cult)|crate]] in the basement for a [[Chest key (Hazeel Cult)|chest key]] (make sure to finish the dialogue to get the key in your inventory). Go up the ladder, then up the stairs and knock on the wall in the east room, on the northern side, then finally go up the ladder. Use the key on the chest to get the scroll. Return to Alomone to start Hazeel's resurrection.{{Clear}}

===An abandoned village===
[[File:Trufitus chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Head to the small village of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]], located south of [[Brimhaven]] on [[Karamja]]. Talk to [[Trufitus]], found in a small house north-east of the main village area, and ask him where everyone is. He will explain they are afraid to stay in the village. Ask him how you can help, and he will ask for several [[herb]]s to mix a [[potions|potion]] to commune with the gods, in order to see what fate befalls them.

:'''Note:''' You cannot collect all of the herbs at once. You will need to go back to talk with Trufitus each time.
