===Snake Weed===
Head south-west of the village near the ocean to find [[marshy jungle vine]]. Search it to get a [[grimy snake weed]]; this may take 1-5 minutes depending on your [[Herblore]] level. Clean the herb and give it to [[Trufitus]].

:'''Note''': If you intend to do [[Legends' Quest]] and [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]], take two extra to save yourself time later.

===Ardrigal===
Head north-east of [[Trufitus]]' hut until you reach a peninsula with several [[palm tree (Ardrigal)|palm trees]] on it, just south of the [[Shortcuts|agility shortcut]].

Avoiding the nearby level 46 [[Harpie Bug Swarm]]s, search a palm tree to find a [[grimy ardrigal]]. Clean the herb and give it to [[Trufitus]].

:'''Note:''' If you intend to do [[Legends' Quest]], take an extra to save yourself time later.

===Sito Foil===
{{Color|red|Warning:}} The [[tribesmen]] in this section are aggressive, and can poison you with damage starting at 11.

Immediately south of the village you will find [[scorched earth]]. Search it to find the [[grimy sito foil]]. Clean the herb and give it to [[Trufitus]].

===Volencia Moss===

Head south-east of the hut until you reach a group of [[rock (volencia moss)|rocks]] you can search that are in the mining area, search an empty one to find the [[grimy volencia moss]]. Clean the herb and give it to [[Trufitus]].

:'''Note''': If you intend to do [[Fairytale I - Growing Pains]] take an extra to save yourself time later.

===Rogue's Purse===
{{Needed|recommended=Food for low levels to run past aggressive level 53 Jogres, and combat equipment to kill a level 53 [[Jogre]] for an easy Diary task}}

:'''Note:''' You may kill a [[Jogre]] inside the dungeon for an easy [[Karamja Diary]] task. Take the [[jogre bones]] for [[ Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]]. Although they may drop the grimy [[rogue's purse]], they do not count for the quest.

Run south past the [[aggressive]] level 53 [[Jogre]]s until you find a [[fungus covered cavern wall]]. Search it until you find the grimy rogue's purse (may take some minutes). 

:'''Note''': If you intend to do [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]], take an extra to save yourself time later.

Return to Trufitus with the final cleaned herb.

==Walkthrough==
Talk to the [[Legends' Guard]]s just outside the legends [[Legends' Guild|guild]] ([[fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|blr}}), and they'll send you through the gates if you meet the requirements to enter. Talk to Sir [[Radimus Erkle]] to get your assignment. He will request you map the [[Kharazi Jungle]], befriend a Kharazi tribesman, and bring back a token of friendship to strengthen ties with the Legends Guild. You should receive [[Radimus notes]].

If you don't have them already, take 3-5 [[papyrus]] from the table, and grab a [[machete]] from the [[Cupboard (Legends' Quest)|cupboard]]. If [[Radimus Erkle]] prevents you from taking one, you can also buy one from the [[Obli's General Store|general store]] in [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]].

===Transport and banking===
You will need to bank several times during the quest. Depending on stats and risk tolerance, it may be possible to complete more steps in a single trip, so read ahead to see what will be required.

If you have unlocked [[fairy rings]], the shortest way to the jungle is code {{Fairycode|ckr}}. When you need to bank, teleport out of the jungle and return using the fairy ring. Wearing a charged [[amulet of glory]] or [[ring of wealth]] throughout the quest provides a convenient teleport close to a bank and fairy ring ([[Edgeville]] and the [[Grand Exchange]] respectively). It may be worth taking the alternative route to Shilo Village on the first trip, to buy charcoal and papyrus.

If not using the fairy rings, make your way to [[Brimhaven]] by taking a boat from [[Ardougne]] or any [[charter ship]]. Then, you can take [[Shilo Village cart system|Hajedy's cart]] to [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] (his fee is 200 [[coins]]). Later, you can exit the jungle the same way as entering it, and return to Shilo Village to use the bank.

It will be necessary to exit from the depths of the [[Viyeldi caves]], twice for the short path and three times for the long path. Even for players travelling by cart, teleporting out will be faster than climbing out. If climbing out, you can fail at some obstacles, particularly the strength door (where your attempts to open it from the inside can be interrupted by attacks from [[death wing]]s). Teleporting out also provides an opportunity to bank before continuing.

===Mapping the jungle===
{{Needed|[[Radimus notes]] (he will replace at the [[Legends' Guild]] for 30gp), [[axe]], [[machete]], at least 1 [[charcoal]] (3 to be safe), at least 3 [[papyrus]] (5 to be safe)|skills={{SCP|Crafting|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} to map the jungle with the notes}}

[[File:Legends' Quest - Thick jungle.png|thumb|220px|The jungle is very dense.]]
Head to the jungle boundary south of Shilo Village. To get into the Kharazi Jungle, you'll need to cut your way through the overgrown jungle vegetation using an axe and machete.

Once inside (preferably on the eastern/western sides, so you don't have to run back and forth), start mapping down the jungle with your charcoal and papyrus by right-clicking on the Radimus notes and then selecting 'Complete' ({{SCP|Crafting|50}}). Sometimes the charcoal and/or papyrus can break, so you should bring extra just in case. Alternatively, you may mess up the papyrus, but be able to salvage it. You should watch out for the [[jungle wolf|jungle wolves]], as they are aggressive; the [[Tormented Warrior|tormented warriors]] and oomlie birds aren't aggressive unless provoked (see below).

{{UIMnote|You can drop your charcoal and papyrus after completing the notes all three times.}}

===Extra tasks===
*If you intend on freeing [[Sir Amik Varze]] in [[Recipe for Disaster]], you should grab [[Vanilla pod|vanilla pod(s)]] whilst you are here—they are located directly south-west from the [[Water Pool]] near the beach in a group of five plants.
*Shake a [[leafy palm tree]] to acquire a [[palm leaf]]. Pick up five palm leaves (or pick up and drop the same one five times) to complete a hard task for the [[Karamja Diary]].
*Additionally, kill an [[oomlie bird]] and collect its [[Raw oomlie|meat]]. Use a palm leaf on the raw meat, then cook the resulting [[wrapped oomlie]] over [[fire]] (now or later) and eat the resulting [[oomlie wrap]] to complete another hard task. The wrapped oomlie cannot normally be burned.
*Chop some [[teak]] and [[mahogany]] trees at the pool or southern coastal end (teak) and south-east (mahogany) of the jungle to complete two medium tasks rather than paying 100 [[trading sticks]] to enter the [[Hardwood Grove]].

===Contacting the locals===
{{Needed|[[Radimus notes]], [[axe]], [[machete]], 4 free inventory slots|skills={{SCP|Agility|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} to squeeze past some [[Mossy rock|rocks]]}}

Consider banking here to get the items for the '''Binding book''' section.

Talk to one of the [[jungle forester]]s, who are standing at various points along the outside of the jungle boundary. They have a [[bullroarer]], which they'll be willing to give up if you give them a copy of your notes. Use the completed Radimus notes on the forester, who will then make a copy before giving you their bullroarer.

:'''{{Colour|red|Warning:}}''' Do not use the bullroarer around [[Tormented Warrior|tormented warriors]] or oomlie birds, or you'll be attacked!

{{Map|align=right|mtype=pin|2793,2908|2855,2916|2872,2909|2919,2920|2952,2898|caption='Totem Pole' Locations in Jungle.}}
Go inside the jungle again, and swing it near the totem pole found east of the water pool represented by a blue square on the map to call a local named [[Gujuo]] out of hiding. '''(There are multiple totem poles in the jungle, so if nothing happens, try another one.)''' He'll ask for your help, since his tribe's shaman, [[Ungadulu]], is trapped in his [[Shaman Caves|cave]].
{{Map|2782,2935|r=5|mtype=square|align=left|height=200|width=200|caption=The location of the cave.}}
From now on, you can call Gujuo using the bullroarer from anywhere in the jungle. Towards the north-western edge of the jungle, you'll find some [[Mossy rock|rocks]] that you can squeeze through to get into the cave ({{SCP|Agility|50}}).

Investigate (right-click) the [[Fire Wall]] and talk to [[Ungadulu]], who warns you not to approach the flames, but becomes possessed and informs you that only pure water can extinguish the flames. Next, search the various items; the [[Bed (Viyeldi caves)|bed]], [[Table (Viyeldi caves)|table]], and [[Crate (Viyeldi caves)|crate]] to obtain Ungadulu's notes: a [[scrawled note]] from the crate; [[a scribbled note]] on the table; and a [[scrumpled note]] on the bed. The crate is in the south-east corner of the room, not near the bed & table. Reading them tells you how the shaman had prepared to summon his ancestors and pay homage to them, but fell prey to an evil presence in the cave.

Once you're back outside again, call [[Gujuo]] with your [[bullroarer]]. Ask him for more information and tell him you need some pure water to douse some magic flames (option 4). Ask, "What kind of a vessel?" (option 5). He'll give you a [[sketch]] of the vessel. (If you do not have these dialogue options, go back inside the cave and speak to [[Ungadulu]] again after you read the notes and they should become available).

[[File:Legends' Quest - Viyeldi caves entrance.png|thumb|right|220px|The entrance to the cave.]]

{{Map:Viyeldi caves}}
{{Clear|left}}
===Binding book===
{{Needed| ''[[Radimus notes]], [[axe]], [[machete]], [[pickaxe]], 1-2 [[lockpick]]s (2 to be safe).'' ''"SMELL" runes: 1 [[soul rune]], 1 [[mind rune]], 1 [[earth rune]], 2 [[law runes]].'' ''Cut [[sapphire]], [[emerald]], [[ruby]], [[diamond]], [[red topaz]], [[jade]], and [[opal]].''|recommended=Supplies to pass level 83 [[Death Wing]]s, and equipment to kill one for the [[Karamja Diary]] if you wish to do it on this trip. (The second trip may be more convenient, as you will need combat equipment anyway. A [[Super restore|super restore potion]] if your level is not far above the required level stated below.|skills={{SCP|Agility|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} to squeeze through the crevice, {{SCP|Thieving|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} to pick the locked door, {{SCP|Mining|52}} {{Boostable|yes}} to smash three [[Boulder (Shaman Caves)|boulders]] (consider bringing 2-3 boosts if boosting), {{SCP|Strength|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} to force the heavy door.}}

'''Make sure that you have all the required items.''' Go back to the cave. Ignore the fire wall and head to the east side of the room. Squeeze through a crevice hidden behind the [[Bookcase (Shaman Caves)|easternmost bookcase]] by searching it ({{SCP|Agility|50}}).

As you proceed further into the cave, you will come across an [[Ancient Gate]]. Attempt to pick the lock ({{SCP|Thieving|50}}). If you fail, clicking elsewhere during the dialogue box will save your lockpick and you can try again.

Once past this door, you'll need a [[pickaxe]] to mine three [[Boulder (Shaman Caves)|boulders]] out of the way ({{SCP|Mining|52}}). If you fail, your [[Mining]] level will decrease by 1. Once past these three boulders, use brute force to open the next set of [[Ancient Gate#Second gate|gates]] ({{SCP|Strength|50}}); failing this will result in your [[Strength]] being lowered. Beware of level 83 [[Death Wing]]s on the other side; activating [[Protect from Melee|Protect From Melee]] can completely negate their damage. Killing a Death Wing, either now or on the second visit, will complete a hard task in the [[Karamja Diary]].

Run farther into the cave, and jump over the [[jagged wall]]. When you get further inside, you'll find a place where there are [[Marked wall|markings on the wall]]. Read them and it will give you the riddle:
:''"Place five stones of magical power - but place them wrong, and your fate will sour. First is the spirit of man or beast (Soul rune), second the place where fools tread least (Mind rune). Third is the soil where plants do grow (Earth Rune) -- and four and five are the rules you must know (Two Law Runes). Solve this riddle, and overcome your ignorance; arranged correct, it should make sense."''

[[File:Gems locations.png|thumb|223x223px|Gems location for puzzle]]
It spells SMELL. Use the runes with the wall in the order of Soul, Mind, Earth, Law, Law and then the door will appear. If the runes are used in an incorrect order, you will have to leave and re-enter the cave. 
[[File:Legends' Quest - Binding book.png|thumb|220px|Retrieving the binding book]]
Inside are a number of [[carved rock]]s sitting in pools of water. Search the rocks to find the next riddle:
:''"Once there were crystals to make the pool shine. Ordered in stature to retrieve what's mine."''

''Crystals'' refers to [[gem]]s, and ''ordered in stature'' refers to arranging them in ascending order of their [[Crafting]] level requirement. Starting at the ancient gate, use the gems in ascending order (from North to South, East to West) on each carved rock (refer to the diagram on the right). The sequence in which you do this does not matter, as long as you use each gem on the correct rock. You will '''not''' lose the gem if you use it on an incorrect one.

{{Bug|Attempting to take the gem back after it has been placed on the stalagmites can cause it to be lost forever.}}

When all of the gemstones are in place, there will be a little light show. Take the [[binding book]] that appears.

Once you have the binding book, teleport away or leave the cave to restock.

:'''Note:''' If you lose the binding book, you must repeat the steps above, though the "SMELL" runes are no longer needed.

===Gold bowl===
{{Needed|[[Sketch]], [[hammer]], 2-6 [[gold bar]]s|skills={{SCP|Smithing|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create the [[gold bowl]]}}

'''{{Ironman}} note''': If you're planning on gathering magic logs from the yommi tree using the yommi tree sapling method described later, you do not need to make additional gold bowls.

Go to any [[anvil]] while holding the sketch of the vessel you obtained from Gujuo and try to make the [[gold bowl]] ({{SCP|Smithing|50}}). You may easily fail even at higher smithing levels, so to be safe, bring more than two bars. If walking, the closest anvil is in [[Tai Bwo Wannai Village]]. If you can use fairy rings and have 60 smithing, you can use the minigame teleport to [[Blast Furnace]] for an anvil, take a mine cart back to the [[Grand Exchange]], then use the fairy ring there to return to the jungle.

{{UIMnote|You can now drop your Sketch after successfully making a Gold bowl.}}

===Pure water===
{{Needed|[[Radimus notes]], [[axe]], [[machete]], [[bullroarer]], [[gold bowl]], [[prayer potion]] (if you fail to bless the bowl and your prayer drops below 42)|recommended=Bring the items for '''Freeing Ungadulu'''|skills= {{SCP|Prayer|42}} {{Boostable|yes}} to bless the bowl}}

Head back into the jungle and call [[Gujuo]]. He'll help you bless your gold bowl so that it can carry the pure water. Your [[prayer points]] must be ''at or above'' 42 to attempt this, and if you fail, it will drain 5 prayer points. If it drains your prayer below 42, you'll have to restore it to try again.

To bless multiple bowls, talk to Gujuo again (without saying "thanks for your help").

With your [[blessed golden bowl]], head to the pool of pure water towards the middle of the jungle. Since you can't quite reach the water, cut a [[hollow reed]] by using your [[machete]] on the tall reeds by the edge of the pool, then use the reed on the pool to siphon the water into your bowl. If you left-click the reeds, you will receive a message saying you need a knife to cut them, but a machete works just as well. Note that if you leave the jungle, the water in your bowl may evaporate, requiring you to refill the bowl again when you return.

===Freeing Ungadulu===
{{Needed|[[Radimus notes]], [[axe]], [[machete]], [[bullroarer]], [[binding book]], [[blessed gold bowl]] filled with pure water, Combat equipment and food to kill a level 187 demon|recommended=Several [[prayer potion]]s|skills={{SCP|Agility|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} to enter the cave}}

[[File:Legends' Quest - Fighting Nezikchened.png|thumb|220px|Nezikchened, the demon possessing Ungadulu.]]
There is an upcoming fight, so be prepared. '''''If you die during the fight, you will have to re-obtain all quest items.'''''  When you're ready, use your pure water on the fire wall to step through without damage. Then, use your [[binding book]] on [[Ungadulu]] to release the demon, [[Nezikchened]]. Do not talk to or attack Ungadulu. (If you talk to him, he will damage you. If you attack him, he will damage you and knock you out of the octogram.)

Nezikchened is level 187 and will drain a large amount of [[prayer]] (90%) at the beginning of the battle, but never again after that, so be careful if you want to use it while fighting him. Additionally, he'll cast a [[Fire Blast]] just before dying, so make sure to keep your [[HP]] up so that he doesn't kill you with his last ditch attack. '''This Fire Blast will hit through the [[Protect from Magic]] prayer.'''

[[Arclight]] is heavily recommended for its damage and accuracy boost, as well as its stat-lowering special attack versus demons. If unavailable, other [[demonbane weapons]] (e.g. [[Silverlight]], [[Darklight]], [[Holy water|Holy Water]]) may be used alongside a higher-tier weapon. The [[Desk (Viyeldi caves)|desk]] can be used as a [[safespot]], resulting in Nezikchened switching to [[Magic]] attacks.

:'''Note:''' There seems to be a glitch where if there is more than one person in the room (not inside the octagram), Nezikchened may go [[aggressive]] on the other player. This then makes Nezikchened completely harmless and unable to attack the player.
:'''Note:''' If you don't kill [[Nezikchened]] fast enough, he will reset, causing you to have to use the book on Ungadulu again. The combat will reset, restoring him to full [[health]] and re-draining your [[prayer]].

Once Nezikchened is defeated, talk to Ungadulu. Ungadulu will thank you and give you some [[yommi tree seeds]]. '''Be careful not to attack him as this will knock you out of the octogram and deal some damage, and if your health is low after the fight, this may kill you.''' You can use the [[drop trick]] to get more yommi tree seeds, to save time later if you lose the plants to rotting or if you are an [[Ironman]] and want to get [[magic logs]]. Ask Ungadulu how to get out, and he will tell you that he cast a spell to protect you from the flames. You can now walk through the flames at any time without the bowl.

{{UIMnote|You can now drop the Binding Book.}}

Exit the cave, head back to the pure water pool, and refill your bowl with water if needed. Then, use it on the [[yommi tree seeds]] to germinate them. (Doing this will empty all your bowls if you had more than one, and you cannot plant the seed without more pure water.) After germinating the seeds, attempt to refill your bowl again to discover the pool is now gross with sludge. We will need to cleanse the pool during the next section before we can plant the seeds. (You must use a hollow reed on the pool to get the next dialogue from Gujuo.) 

Call [[Gujuo]]. He will tell you that the underground source has probably been blocked off, and you'll need a [[bravery potion]] to be able to make it through the dark tunnel.

===Bravery potion===
{{Needed|[[Ardrigal]], [[snake weed]], [[vial of water]]}}

{{Map|align=right|mtype=pin|caption=The locations of the herbs for the bravery potion.
|2875,3121,title:[[Ardrigal]],desc:
|2764,3046,title:[[Snake weed]],desc:
}}
To make the potion you need [[Ardrigal]] (obtained during the [[Jungle Potion]] quest) and [[Snake weed]]. The [[Snake weed]] can be found south-west of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] by searching the [[Marshy jungle vine|green and yellow vines]] on the ground and the [[Ardrigal]] can be found north-east of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] along the shore by the [[Harpie Bug Swarm|Harpie Bug Swarms]] by searching the large-leafed [[palm tree (Ardrigal)|palm trees]] by the agility shortcut. Mix the herbs into the vial of water (in either order) to make the [[bravery potion]]. You can drink it now to save space.

===Finding the water source===
'''''Items required:'''''

*''[[Radimus notes]], [[axe]], [[machete]], [[pickaxe]], 1-2 [[Lockpick|lockpicks]], [[rope]], [[Blessed Gold Bowl]], and [[Bravery Potion]] (if it has not been consumed yet).''
*''[[Unpowered orb]] and [[runes]]/[[elemental staff|staff]] to cast any [[Charge Orb]] spell (note that at Magic level 56 you can only cast the Charge Water Orb spell). Bring 2 sets if taking the long path and you don't intend to bank between the two descents of the cave. Be on normal spellbook.''
*''[[Food]] and [[potions]] to fight the three warriors followed by [[Nezikchened]]. If taking the long path and teleporting out of the cave, you can restock before fighting Nezikchened.''
*''Bring boosts needed to access the cave again.''

'''''Skills required:''''' {{SCP|Magic|56}} {{Boostable|yes}} ''to cast a [[Charge Orb]] spell.'' {{SCP|Crafting|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} ''to use the furnace. In addition, the skills to go through the [[Shaman Caves|cave]] again (indicated above)<!--: 50 [[Agility]], 50 [[Thieving]], 52 [[Mining]] and 50 [[Strength]].''-->''

'''''Recommended items: '''[[Super restore potion]] in case of failed obstacles. [[Salve amulet]] or [[Salve amulet (e)]] for fighting the 3 [[undead]] warriors.''

Go back to [[Ungadulu's cave]] and head down into the cave again, going through all the same areas that you did before. Kill a [[death wing]] on the way past if you have yet to complete a [[Karamja Diary#Hard|Karamja Hard Task]].

When you reach the area with the seven pools, head further to where another door is. Cast any [[Charge Orb]] spell on it to go through. You'll find yourself in a room with several [[Barrel (Viyeldi caves)|barrels]] in it. You can smash them to reveal things like [[food]], [[rope]], [[weapons]], or often enemies. For now though, ignore them.

Use your rope on the [[Winch (Viyeldi caves)|winch]] and drink the bravery potion before heading down into the depths of the [[Viyeldi caves]]. If you've brought along a [[Salve amulet]], now is the time to equip it. If the rope disappears, searching the winch again will cause it to reappear. Climb down the winch. '''You may lose your grip on the rope and fall into the pit, leading to moderate damage (15+)'''.

You'll be on the top of a long, winding path with several [[Rocky Ledge|rocks]] covering it. The [[Blue hat (Legends' Quest)|blue wizard hat]] to the right of the ladder is the spirit of [[Viyeldi]], which you can take to talk to or skip past for now. Climb over these rocks to the bottom of the path, but be warned. '''If you fall off, you can take extremely heavy damage (40+)''', depending on where you fell. You may also be immediately attacked by one of the three warriors mentioned below.

Once at the bottom, you'll see three groups of different [[undead]] warriors named [[Ranalph Devere]] (level 92), [[Irvig Senay]] (level 100), and [[San Tojalon]] (level 106), who will drop the [[Lump of crystal|lump]], [[Hunk of crystal|hunk]], and [[chunk of crystal]], respectively. Approach them and fight them individually. There are multiple of each warrior in the room. If you are using [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]], hiding behind one of the empty ore rocks allows you to [[safespot]] them. Once you've defeated them, they won't attack again. Take the crystals over to the [[Furnace (Viyeldi caves)|furnace]] to the north-east, and put them in to make a [[heart crystal]].

Go south to the shimmering field and look at the [[minimap]]. If you haven't noticed already, the area to the north-north-west looks like the head of a dragon.
[[File:Legends' Quest - Viyeldi caves mossy rock.png|thumb|220x220px|The mossy rock that players must use the heart crystal on to activate it.]]
Go to where the eye is, and use the crystal on a [[Mossy rock (Viyeldi caves)|mossy rock]] there. It will glow. Go back to the shimmering field, place the crystal in the heart-shaped recess next to it, and pass through the barrier. On the other side of the barrier are three [[lesser demon]]s, and past them to the west is the source of the pure water.

===The second battle===
{{Needed|recommended=[[Demonbane weapons]] (e.g. [[Arclight]], [[Silverlight]], [[Darklight]])}}
[[File:Legends' Quest - Echned Zekin appears.png|thumb|220x220px|Echned Zekin, the ancient spirit.]]

You'll notice that there is a boulder blocking the water flow. Try to push it, and a spirit named Echned Zekin (which is an anagram of [[Nezikchened]]) will appear. He'll say he's being tortured and beg you to help him by killing the spirit, [[Viyeldi]]. He'll give you a [[dark dagger]] to do so.

If you have no intentions of killing Viyeldi, you still have to accept the dagger from Echned, as the dagger must be given to [[Ungadulu]] in order to proceed with the quest.

There are now two paths to choose from.

:'''Note:''' Players who leave the cave will need another [[Charge Orb]] spell to get through the door again. You will not need another rope or bravery potion.

====The short path====
'''Note: If you choose the short path, you will have to fight the three undead warriors again in the final battle!'''

Do as the spirit asks. Walk back to the rock path with the blue wizard hat that you climbed down, and climb the rocks back up to the very top (you cannot fail here).

You may have noticed a [[Blue hat (Legends' Quest)|blue wizard hat]] on the way in—maybe even tried to pick it up. If you did, you met a spirit named [[Viyeldi]], who [[Echned]] wanted you to kill. Stab him with the [[dark dagger]] (use the dagger on him while the dialogue is shown); then, go back down to the boulder.

Before pushing the boulder, proceed to the southern boulder if you wish to [[safespot]] [[Nezikchened]]. Tell Echned Zekin that you did as he asked, use dark dagger on him. Nezikchened will reveal himself and attack the player, draining the player's [[Prayer]].

'''After the battle, push the boulder out of the way of the water's flow and fill the bowl from the pool below it.''' You may need to try from different angles, try from the East side.

====The long path====
{{Needed|[[Dark dagger]]; the same items as for '''Finding the water source''', including another unpowered orb and runes to cast any [[Charge Orb]] spell (but you will not need another rope or bravery potion), and at least one empty inventory space.}}

:''Skip the "long path" if you did the short path.''

Do not try to pick up the [[Blue hat (Legends' Quest)|blue hat]] or talk to [[Viyeldi]].

Bank if desired. Go back to the beginning of the cave, investigate the [[fire wall]] and [[Ungadulu]]'s magic will allow you to pass through the fire wall safely. Use the [[dark dagger]] on Ungadulu. He will recognise the evil in the dagger and take it from you, giving you a [[Holy Force]] spell card, which will reveal the spirit's true form. '''Note:''' Make sure to have one empty inventory space, otherwise the dagger will be taken, but you will '''not''' receive the Holy force card, meaning you must obtain the dagger again.

Now, head back down to the bottom once again. You'll have to use another [[Charge Orb]] spell to get back in (including another unpowered orb). Search the winch to make the rope reappear.

At the bottom, you'll have to fight [[Nezikchened]] again. Choose the southern boulder if you wish to safespot him. Push the boulder and Echned will appear again. Do not tell him you lost the dagger or he will damage you. To start the fight, cast the Holy Force spell (left-click on the card) when Echned is near you, and he will transform into Nezikchened and attack you. At the start of the battle, your Prayer will be halved. Nezikchened fights with a very ineffective [[magic]] attack at the beginning of the battle, and he'll soon realise that it doesn't work and will switch to [[melee]]. Defeat him however you like. '''After the battle, push the boulder out of the way of the water's flow and fill the bowl from the pool below it.''' You may need to try from different angles, try from the East side.

:'''Note:''' If you don't kill [[Nezikchened]] fast enough, he will reset, causing you to have to push the boulder again to talk to him. The combat will reset, and he will have full [[health]] as well as drain your [[prayer]] again.

===Restoring the totem===
{{Needed|[[Radimus notes]], [[axe]] ([[Rune axe|rune]] or higher required to cut the [[yommi tree]]), [[machete]], [[bullroarer]], [[yommi seeds]], [[blessed gold bowl]], and any [[equipment]]/[[potions]]/[[food]] you need for the most difficult battle of this quest|skills={{SCP|Herblore|45}} {{Boostable|yes}} to plant the [[yommi tree seeds]] and {{SCP|Woodcutting|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create the [[yommi totem]]}}

*'''Note for Ironmen: You may wish to do this before proceeding further in the quest.''' 16 [[Magic logs]] are required for other quests, and the logs can be challenging to obtain for ironmen. Allowing a [[yommi tree]] to die and then chopping it down has a 1/4 chance to yield magic logs. This can be done quickly by not watering it, letting it die in the sapling stage, and hopping between three separate worlds. At the minimum [[Herblore]] requirement to plant the tree, about 192 seeds should be enough to get 16 magic logs accounting for a high (66%) failure rate from planting the seeds. When a dead tree is chopped down, the soil is damaged, so the player will have to hop worlds or move to another spot. It's possible to walk/run between two fertile soils and plant two yommi trees at once. While this method is time consuming, it is more consistent and has lower requirements than other early [[Magic logs#Obtaining magic logs|sources for magic logs]].

Return to the pure water pool, then use the bullroarer to call [[Gujuo]] for instructions on what to do next. Fill the bowl again. Find a patch of [[Fertile Soil (scenery)|fertile soil]] - it will be bare of vegetation and brown on the map. Plant the germinated seeds in the fertile soil ({{SCP|Herblore|45}}) and wait for the tree to grow. If it says you planted the seeds incorrectly, just keep trying until it works (the chance of planting it successfully is based on your Herblore level). The growing process only takes a matter of seconds so be prepared. Once the tree reaches the second stage, use your bowl of water on it. The third and final stage is the '''adult''' yommi tree. Use your axe on it, and keep doing this until you've chopped all the branches off and shaped it into a [[yommi totem]] ({{SCP|Woodcutting|50}}). You'll know it's done when you can pick it up.
[[File:Legends' Quest - Chopping yommi tree.png|thumb|220x220px|A player creating the yommi totem.]]

*'''Note:''' Keep alert, because once the Yommi tree has reached the adult stage, you'll have only a brief window of time where you can cut it, or it will go rotten, and you will need to start again.

If you lose all your seeds, you can always go back and get more from [[Ungadulu]] in the cave. Remember to germinate them with the sacred water.

===The final battle===
Now, find any of the locations where there's an old, brown totem. One is located just east of the pool, but there are others all over the forest. Once you find one, make all the preparations you need to fight. Turn on [[Protect from Melee]] and use your new totem on the old one.

Note: you cannot replace the totem if you have inspected it recently. Wait a short time for it to return to its default state.

[[File:Legends' Quest - Final Nezikchened fight.png|thumb|220x220px|Nezikchened returns to destroy the hero once and for all.]]
When [[Nezikchened]] spawns, he will say his dialogue and begin attacking you! You are immobile while he is speaking and can take heavy damage, so '''it is highly recommended to turn on Protect from Melee before replacing the totem to be safe'''.

If you chose the '''short path''', you will need to kill the three undead warriors you saw down in the [[Viyeldi caves|dragon cave]] once again. He will summon them one at a time, going from the strongest to weakest in terms of combat level. After each hero is killed, make sure that Protect from Melee is up as the interlude repeats, and [[Nezikchened]] will freely hit you four times on three occasions, which can deal a lot of damage if he gets lucky with his hits. '''Low levels should note that if you kill the three undead warriors and then leave, you will not have to fight them again upon returning.'''

If you took the '''long path''', Nezikchened will not summon the undead heroes because Viyeldi is protecting them, but be cautious as he will hit four times before the fight.

Nezikchened will attack and drain your [[prayer]]. He attacks with [[Melee]] and [[Magic]], which is much more effective this time. He doesn't use Magic that much if you melee him. Using [[Ranged]], Magic, or a [[halberd]] from between the trees with [[Protect from Magic]] on will allow you to defeat him without losing [[health]].

:'''{{Colour|red|Warning:}}''' If you take too long to fight him, he will disappear. When you resummon him, he returns with full health.

===Finishing up===
When [[Nezikchened]] dies, replace the totem, and [[Gujuo]] will appear to thank you for defeating the demon. He'll give you a totem pole as a reward for everything you've done.

Return to [[Radimus Erkle]] with the [[Radimus notes]] and [[gilded totem]] ([[fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|blr}}), who will then let you into the guild. He will train you in one of 12 various skills of your choice up to four times. After all the experience rewards are claimed, the quest is complete.

'''Note:''' You will need to talk to Radimus one more time after training to actually complete the quest. Without talking to him again, it will not be marked in the questlog and you won't receive the Quest Points.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
[[File:Elemental Workshop I - Odd looking wall.png|thumb|195x195px|The odd looking wall.]]
[[File:Elemental Workshop I - Fixing bellows.png|thumb|195x195px|A player fixes the bellows.]]
===Bound under lock and key===
Head to [[Seers' Village]] and into the house immediately south-west of the bank, indicated by the quest start icon. Search the [[bookcase (Elemental Workshop I)|bookcase]] on the east wall to receive a [[battered book]]. '''Read it''' to start the quest. 

The book details the discovery of a new ore in the [[Fifth Age]], and the workshop erected to work the new material. After the true power of the unique ore was realised, the workshop was closed and bound under lock and key. The book hints that the secret to entering the workshop lies within it.

After reading it, use a [[knife]] (one spawns in the house north of the church) or [[slash weapon]] on the book to get a [[battered key]], turning it into a [[slashed book]] in the process. '''Do not drop''' the slashed book.

Enter the northern building with the [[anvil]] icon, and use the key on the odd-looking wall with the strange crack. Climb down the stairs you find there to enter the [[Elemental Workshop (location)|workshop]].[[File:Elemental Workshop (location) map.png|thumb|left|200px|A map of the [[Elemental Workshop (location)|dungeon]].]]
[[File:Elemental Workshop I - Filling a stone bowl.png|thumb|195x195px|A player filling a stone bowl with lava.]]
[[File:Elemental Workshop I Location of Leather.png|alt=Located in the north-west section of crates.|thumb|195x195px|The crate containing leather.]]
[[File:Elemental Workshop I Location of Stone Bowl.png|alt=Located in the north eastern part of the central area.|thumb|195x195px|The crate containing a stone bowl.]]

===Restarting===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Crafting|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to fix the [[bellows (Elemental Workshop)|bellows]], {{SCP|Mining|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to mine an [[elemental rock]]}}
In the northern chamber is an inactive [[Water wheel (Elemental Workshop)|water wheel]], with two water controls to the west and east of it. Turn the east water control and then the west one to change them both to green (this must be done in order, turn the west one back if you turned it first). After this, pull the lever next to the water wheel. The water wheel should now be spinning.

Next you will need to repair the bellows, found in the eastern chamber. If you did not bring leather and a needle, they may be found in a [[Crate (Elemental Workshop I, leather)|crate]] in the north-western part of the central room, and a [[Crate (Elemental Workshop I, needle)|stacked crate]] in the western room respectively.

Fix the bellows with a spool of thread and leather ({{SCP|Crafting|20}}), then pull the lever next to it. The bellows should begin pumping air. 

Head into the western cavern and attempt to mine an elemental rock ({{SCP|Mining|20}}). The rock springs to life, yells, and attacks you. Kill the [[earth elemental]], and pick up the [[elemental ore]] that it drops. The elementals walking around do not count; it must be an elemental awoken by an attempt to mine them.

:'''Tip:''' Kill two more if you want to save time for [[Elemental Workshop II]], or three more if you also want a [[Mind shield]] after completing that quest.

:'''Tip:''' You may choose to kill one of each elemental in the workshop to complete an easy [[Easy Kandarin Diary|Kandarin Diary]] task. You must kill a regular earth elemental for this, not the ones that are mined first.

Finally, head back to the central chamber. Search the [[Boxes (Elemental Workshop)|boxes]] north-east of the hatch to obtain [[a stone bowl]]. Fill it with lava from the lava trough in the southern chamber, then use it on the [[furnace]] to the east in the same chamber. The inside of the furnace should now glow orange.

===A lost art===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Smithing|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to smith [[elemental metal]] and [[elemental shield]]}}
Proceed to use the elemental ore, along with four [[coal]], on the furnace to obtain an [[elemental metal]] ({{SCP|Smithing|20}}). If this does not work, ensure that you used the elemental ore on the furnace rather than the coal, and that both the water wheel and bellows were successfully activated in the previous steps.

With the [[slashed book]] in your inventory, use the elemental metal on the workbench in the centre to make an [[elemental shield]] ({{SCP|Smithing|20}}). If you are unable to craft the shield, destroy the slashed book and obtain a new one from the bookcase.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Tip''': You may choose to create more shields after the quest, returning with the battered key, slashed book and 4 coal to smelt with the elemental ore. The shield may also be sold on the [[Grand Exchange]] for {{Coins|{{GEP|Elemental shield}}}} gold, costing {{Coins|{{GEP|Coal}}*4}} to create.

==Walkthrough==
===Lighthouse trouble===
{{Needed|60 [[steel nails]], a [[hammer]], and 2 [[plank]]s|recommended=Fast travel method to the Barbarian Outpost and back|skills={{SCP|Agility|35}} {{Boostable|yes}} to enter the pipe inside the [[Barbarian Outpost Agility Course|agility course]]}}
[[File:Larrissa chathead.png|left]]
Head to the [[Lighthouse]], located north of [[Barbarian Outpost]], reachable via the [[Basalt rock|basalt platforms]]. If travelling from the outpost, you can obtain the required planks from the north-east end along the fence. Bring [[food]] as the platforms have a high failure rate even with decent agility, and a max hit of 10. Alternatively, [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|alp}} will take you right by the lighthouse.

Speak to [[Larrissa]], who will tell the player that her boyfriend lives in the lighthouse. She is worried about him, as the light has gone out and the door is now mysteriously locked. Ask how you can help; she is stranded here, as a storm destroyed the bridge to the east, and she wants you to repair it. She also requests you retrieve a spare key to the lighthouse from her cousin at the [[Barbarian Outpost]].

[[File:Horror from the Deep bridge.png|thumb|Repairing the bridge.|220px]]

Some distance east of Larrissa is a broken bridge that connects to the mainland. With a [[hammer]] and 60 [[steel nails]] in your inventory, use a [[plank]] on the side of the bridge you are on, then click to jump to the other side to use a [[plank]] there as well. Depending on your agility level, you may take slight damage from the leap. Once the bridge is fixed, you will be able to cross without failure, despite the bridge not looking any different. 

Check your quest log to make sure it says that you've fixed the bridge, then head to the [[Barbarian Outpost]]. Speak to [[Gunnjorn]], found inside the [[Agility]] course, through the pipe ({{SCP|Agility|35}}). Tell him Larrissa is in trouble and needs her spare key back, and he will give you the [[lighthouse key]].

===Fixing the Lightomatic Deluxe 500===
{{Needed|A [[tinderbox]], [[molten glass]], and [[swamp tar]]}}
 [[File:Lighting mechanism (broken).png|left|100px]]
Return to Larrissa. She asks you to go inside the lighthouse and find out what happened to [[Jossik]]. Enter the building; you will appear in an [[instance]] with Larrissa inside. The furniture is smashed and there are blood splatters and claw marks on the floor and walls. She asks you to repair the light mechanism to prevent any shipwrecks. She does not know how to, but says Jossik probably had some manuals lying around.

By searching the bookcase on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, you may find the [[manual|lighthouse manual]], Jossik's [[Journal (Horror from the Deep)|journal]], and his [[diary (Horror from the Deep)|uncle's diary]]. Reading these  is not required to progress the quest. If you choose to read them, the manual will describe how to maintain the [[Lightomatic]] Deluxe 500, with a troubleshooting FAQ section at the end of the book. The journal describes how Jossik became the lighthouse keeper after his uncle disappeared, and soon began to hear voices. It ends with Jossik's decision to investigate the strange noises coming from the basement. In his diary [[Silas]] discusses the monstrous [[dagannoth]] in-between incoherent ramblings, as well as his construction of a metal door in the basement. He mentions that to unlock the door, 'the key' is fire, air, water, and earth runes, as well as weapons.

Head to the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} and use some [[molten glass]] and [[swamp tar]] on the lighting mechanism in order to fix it, then light the tar with a [[tinderbox]]. Return to Larrissa, who requests that you do everything to find Jossik.

===The door is the key===
{{Needed|One of each elemental [[runes|rune]], 1 [[arrow]], and 1 [[sword]]}}
[[File:Horror from the Deep - The strange door.png|left|120px]]
Go down the iron ladder into the basement to find the door mentioned in Jossik's journal. You appear in a kind of sea cavern, with further passage blocked by the [[strange wall (Lighthouse)|metal door]]. It has a monstrous face in its centre surrounded by six icons: the four runes, a sword and an arrow.

Use all of your basic elemental [[runes]] on the door ([[Fire rune|fire]], [[Water rune|water]], [[Earth rune|earth]], and [[Air rune|air]]). You may bring a full stack of each, as the door will only use one rune. Use your [[sword]] on the door (any type), and then an [[arrow]] (any type except [[ogre arrows|ogre]] and [[training arrows|training]]). Bolts will not work. '''You do not get these back!'''

===Horrors from the deep===
{{Needed|Combat equipment}}

Once you have used all of the items on the door, it will unlock. Ensure you have your combat equipment with you, and go through the eastern part of the door and down the ladder. Be prepared to fight both a [[dagannoth]] and the [[dagannoth mother]], then talk to [[Jossik]] sitting injured by the ladder, who says he was trapped down here by creatures that attacked him. When the player suggests they should return upstairs to find help, a level 100 [[dagannoth]] emerges from the sea and attacks!
[[File:Horror from the Deep first dagannoth.png|thumb|Safespotting the first dagannoth.|200px]]
The [[Dagannoth (Horror from the Deep)|dagannoth]] only attacks with melee and can be killed with any combat style. You can utilise a [[safespot]] by standing in the southern corner of the pond to the west.

After defeating it, Jossik says that was not the creature that had attacked him but one of its babies. A cutscene follows in which a larger dagannoth appears from the waters, revealing itself to be the much stronger [[dagannoth mother]]. She attacks with both ranged and melee, and changes colour every 18 seconds through a fixed cycle, indicated through a chat message {{Mes|The Dagannoth changes to blue...}} as well as visually. Her six colours correspond to the four elemental spell types, ranged, and melee. For as long as she remains that colour, she can only be damaged through use of that particular attack style.

The same safespot used for the regular dagannoth is not as effective here, as she may eventually attack you. You can use the stalagmites in the south-east corner of the room to [[flinch]] with a melee weapon, using [[Protect from Missiles]] to avoid her ranged attack when using the other combat styles. By default, the mother will use ranged at a distance and melee up close, but may detect [[Prayer]] changes and automatically use the opposite attack type.

You can defeat the [[Dagannoth mother]] without using all of the combat styles, and may choose to simply wait in a [[safespot]] (or up the ladder) while she is the wrong colour. You could also use these pauses to heal. As she has a weakness to [[earth spells]] and only level 1 [[Magic]], this is the most effective source of damage.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/636095399070158848|date=25 August 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107525|archivedate=26 May 2020|quote=NPCs' magic defence is calculated off their Magic level, not their Defence level, and his is negligible.}} [[Ranged]] is the second most effective, and she has a higher resistance to [[melee]].

'''Note''': The [[Twinflame staff]] is not recommended, as it will remain on [[Earth spells]] as the mother's weakness, even if she has changed colour.

{{Color|red|Warning:}} Any dropped items will be unobtainable after defeating the boss. You may still loot your items if you die before killing her.

Defeating the [[Dagannoth mother]] will automatically complete the quest, and you will receive a [[rusty casket]]. The casket can be obtained from [[Jossik]] upstairs if you had a full inventory.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Preparation===
{{Map|3440,3232|mtype=square|r=6|align=right|caption=The [[Abandoned Mine]] is located south-west of [[Mort Myre Swamp]].}}
To begin the quest, players need to head to the [[Abandoned Mine]], which can be found in the south-westernmost part of [[Morytania]], south of the swamps and west of [[Mort'ton]] and [[Burgh de Rott]]. To reach the abandoned mine players will either have to have started [[Nature Spirit]] or have access to fast travel to Mort'ton or Barrows.

There is a [[low fence]] shortcut from [[Burgh de Rott]] which requires {{SCP|Agility|25}} and partial completion of [[In Aid of the Myreque]], which will save time not running through the swamp to the north of the mine.

{{Color|red|Warning}}: The boss fight is very difficult even for higher combat levels, as you will take a lot of damage regardless of armour. The only nearby bank is the [[Burgh de Rott]] bank unlocked through [[In Aid of the Myreque]], and returning to the boss fight room will require you to redo some steps of the quest, so it is recommended to bring all of your combat gear and supplies for the boss at the start of the quest. Read ahead to the [[Haunted Mine#Treus's wrath|boss fight]] section for tips.

'''Note''': If travelling through the swamp to reach the mine, don't forget your filled [[druid pouch]].

===The mysteries of Mort Ridge===
[[File:Zealot chathead.png|left]]
[[File:Haunted Mine - Zealot.png|thumb|The [[zealot]] tells you about the mine and its contents.]]
In the area between the mine and the swamp, a Saradominist [[zealot]] is walking around. Speak to him and he will demand to know your allegiance. Select any response other than Zamorak, and ask him what he is doing. He will explain that he is on a quest to reclaim the Haunted Mines in the name of Saradomin, and that the legendary [[Salve amulet]], since lost, was carved from the crystals that grow in the lower levels of the mine. The mines are haunted by the condemned soul of [[Treus Dayth]], a Zamorakian mage whose soul was bound by Zamorak to the mines to prevent those crystals from ever being reached again. The zealot hopes to reach these crystals to recreate the [[Salve amulet]].

Ask about other entrances into the mine, and the zealot will confirm that a second entrance may exist, and that he has come into possession of a key granting access to the lower levels of the mine. [[Pickpocket]] him to get [[Zealot's key|his key]] (drops on the floor with full inventory). Follow the cart track to the south (avoiding the the [[feral vampyre]]s) and climb over the mine cart blocking the way, then enter the cart tunnel.

'''Note''': If you don't have {{SCP|Agility|15}}, you cannot climb over the cart - instead, go to the west side of the mountain and enter the southern entrance.

===Into the depths===
{{main|Abandoned Mine}}

You find yourself in a dark cave with many bats, big and small, and many pickaxes and corpses strewn about. There are some hazards to be aware of throughout the mine:

* Some skeletons are dormant; the ones called [[corpse]]s in yellow letters will spring to life and become [[skeletal miner]]s when you approach
* Some pickaxes may become [[Possessed pickaxe|possessed]] and attack you when you attempt to pick them up
* Creepy [[haze]]s are spooky but generally harmless (although they can sometimes turn into aggressive [[ghost]]s when adjacent to them)
* [[Mine cart (Abandoned Mine)|Mine cart]]s moving of their own accord will damage you if you get in their way

Your task is to make your way to the depths of the caves and find the Salve crystal. Follow the cart track to the west and exit the cave on the western side (ignore the ladder). Once outside, enter the southern entrance (the same one used if you didn't climb over the cart).

Climb down the ladder at the end of the blocked path. Head east and climb down the next ladder.

Follow the path to the cart track running north to south. '''Wait until the moving cart has headed south''', then follow it and wait in the western alcove to the south. When the cart passes north, run south to the ladder and climb down.

[[File:Glowing fungi.png|thumb|left|A cluster of fungi in a stagnant pool.]]

After climbing down the ladder '''(12)''', you will arrive next to a stagnant pool to the west with [[glowing fungus]] growing '''(X)'''. Pick one; this is to be your light source in the lowest level of the cave (no other light source will work). There is a lift to the east, but you cannot descend in it now - it leads to a flooded area which would extinguish any other light source. You will need to find a way to transport the fungi to the lift without carrying it, as it will crumble to [[ashes]] if taken outside.

{{Colour|red|Warning:}} '''Do not''' take the fungi outside of the cave and also '''do not drop it''', as both actions will cause it to crumble to [[ashes]]. Random events that teleport the player will also destroy the fungi.

====All aboard!====
Head north-west along the track until you reach a searchable mine cart. Place the fungus in the cart '''(T)'''. Head north and then west to the [[Points settings]] '''(P)''' panel, which operates the cart system.

'''Note''': In the alcove immediately south of the panel is an [[Iron pickaxe]]. If you didn't bring a pickaxe but you plan to do the hard [[Morytania Diary]] task during the quest, you can pick this one up without it becoming possessed. Beware of the [[skeletal miner]] corpse becoming reanimated however.


Open the panel, and it will show a map of all the cart tracks on this level as well as ten junctions that can each be in two positions. Pressing the start button sets the cart system in motion. The objective is to get the cart from the start position on the left to the ladder in the top right corner (north-west). 

The map also shows two groups of levers controlling the junctions. The cart will follow the ''crimson (lighter red)'' route at any junction when approaching from the tail direction of the corresponding arrow. Pulling the respective lever exchanges the crimson and burgundy arrows at the junction. The initial configuration will be different for each player, but the solution remains the same (see the image below).

The levers A through E are south-east of the control panel (location '''(Q)''' on the map above), whereas F through J are north, around the corner (location '''(R)'''). Beware of skeletal miners lying in ambush at both stations. The levers F, G and H are inaccessible, meaning those junctions are fixed.

When approaching a junction from the arrow head's direction, its orientation (i.e., colour) does not matter ''as long as it is a straight path''. In order to round a corner and not plunge into a wall or the water, the direction taken by the cart must be marked by a crimson arrow.

<gallery widths="300">
Haunted Mine - Levers A-E.png|Levers A-E.
Haunted Mine - Levers I-K.png|Levers F-K. (The blocked levers F, G & H are unmarked in this picture.)
Haunted Mine - Track map.png|The mine cart route solution.
</gallery>

Operate all the levers in accordance with the rules above and then check the control panel to make sure that the route on your map directs the mine cart to the ladder. Operate the mine cart by pressing the start button and the map will show the path of the mine cart.

Depending on the contents and route of the cart, four outcomes are possible. They are indicated both by the second half of the short cutscene, and a game message or player dialogue:
* {{mes|Oh dear, the mine cart seems to have sunk.}} - The cart sinks into the water. Any fungus in the cart will be destroyed.
* {{mes|How useful, it's come right back to where it started.}} - The cart returns to the start. Any fungus in the cart will still be in the cart.
* '''Player:''' I wonder if that cart is anywhere useful now? - The cart successfully makes it to the other side. The fungus will now be on the other side.
* ''(No message)'' - The cart successfully makes it to the other side. There was no fungus in the cart before sending it.

If the cart sinks, the [[glowing fungus]] is removed from the cart. In that case, pick another glowing fungus and put it in the cart '''(T)'''. Operate the appropriate levers to fix the problem and hit the red button again.

When the mine cart reaches the correct end point, you will remark that it may have ended up somewhere useful. If your character doesn't make a comment about the location of the cart, put another mushroom in and send the cart off again.

====Retrieving the fungus====
You will now have to reach the ladder yourself to retrieve the fungus. First, retrace your steps to the very top of the mine. Go back up the ladder '''(12)''' near the [[Glowing fungus|glowing fungi]] pool. Walk north along the track, avoiding the cart. Take the first path to the east and climb up the ladder at the end of the path. Go west and up the ladder, then exit the cave to the west. You should end up next to the [[River Salve]].

Enter the northern cave. Climb down the first ladder immediately to the east and head north-east through the cave. Climb down the northern ladder to the next level. Head to the north-west corner of the cave and climb down the ladder.

Search the nearby cart and take the glowing fungus that was put in earlier. If there is no fungus in the cart, you will need to repeat the previous process.

'''Note:''' If you die during the boss fight, you will need to get another glowing fungus and send it through the mine cart again, but you will not need to set the levers again as they will remain the same.

===Waterlogged===
{{Needed|Zealot's key, combat equipment and plenty of high-healing [[food]]|recommended=[[stamina potion]], 1-2 [[prayer potions]], one click teleport to escape if needed (e.g [[ectophial]])}}
[[File:Abandoned Mine flooded chamber.png|thumb|200px|Taking a swim from the lift.]]

Do '''not''' take the mine cart track leading south. Instead, climb back up with the fungus in your possession. Head all the way east past the ladder going up and then south past a moving cart. Climb down the ladder to end up in a side cave east of the flooded tracks. Head south down the corridor. Pick up the [[chisel]] from the spawn on top of a crate if you did not bring one. 

In this area there is a water-powered lift going further down but it is not operational. To use it, head around the large pipe and use the [[zealot's key]] on the valve to activate the water flow from the nearby basin. '''Run''' quickly back to the lift and head down, before a [[mischievous ghost]] can shut off the valve. If the ghost beats you, simply turn the valve again and retry.

'''Note''': If you die during the following boss fight, you will not need to use the valve again, and the key is no longer required for access.

[[File:Abandoned Mine - Level 5 map.png|thumb|Abandoned Mine Level 5]]

The lift will drop you into a pool of water, but the cave will be properly lit with the [[glowing fungus]]. From the flooded chamber, walk south onto the track (beware of possessed pickaxes) and '''follow the east track'''. Climb down the stairs ('''14''') and go west into a large chamber with [[loading crane]]s and [[Mine cart (Abandoned Mine)|mine cart]]s. This room is where the boss fight will take place. 

'''Do not take the [[Crystal-mine key|innocent-looking key]] until you are completely ready to begin!'''

'''Note''': If you want to return to the upper levels, simply return to the lift, click on it and you will automatically swim towards it.

===Treus's wrath===
:'''Note:''' ''Read this part fully before entering the fight if you're not experienced with the fight! Especially if you're low [[combat]]! This boss fight is difficult and should not be taken lightly. High-healing food is recommended. The surrounding environment is more dangerous than the actual [[Treus Dayth|boss]] itself.''
[[File:Haunted Mine - Crystal-mine key.png|thumb|220px|The crystal mine key appears suspiciously easy to take.]]
[[File:Treus Dayth chathead.png|left]]
To start the fight, try to pick up the [[Crystal-mine key|innocent-looking key]]. It will float away and return. Click the chatbox to continue the dialogue and the ghost of [[Treus Dayth]] (combat level 95), the erstwhile guardian of the Salve crystals, will appear and start to attack you.

During the fight Treus will use his ghostly powers to turn invisible, and move through obstacles about the room. He cannot be attacked while invisible, and you will need to chase him around the room until he reappears. His location is at any time indicated by a flashing yellow arrow on the minimap. As the fight progresses he will disappear at a faster rate.

There are four methods that Treus uses to damage you:
*''Mine Cart'' - When the player steps on a cart track, a mine cart will be sent tumbling after them. This can hit up to 9 typeless damage every [[game tick]], which can equal to '''36 damage every 2 seconds''' if the player is unlucky. This is the most dangerous attack. This attack can be easily avoided by running across the tracks instead as the cart will only move when the player is in its target range.
*''Crane'' - The possessed cranes will attack the player if the player moves to a square directly adjacent to it, dealing up to 10 typeless damage. This is the second most dangerous attack out of the three.
*''Pickaxes'' - If the player is not near any other obstacle, the player will be attacked by projectile pickaxes. These hit up to 15 damage each. The [[Protect from Missiles]] prayer only provides '''33%''' protection from this attack, reducing it to a max of 10. Pickaxes are the second least dangerous attack.
*''Melee'' - If the player is standing next to Treus Dayth, he may rarely use a melee attack that deals up to 8 damage. This is the least used attack and also the least dangerous.

====Strategy====
As [[Treus]] moves around the room, you will need to chase him across the tracks without staying on them, and while avoiding standing too close to the cranes. Treus will throw pickaxes at you, so you should pray [[Protect from Missiles]] while running around, using [[stamina potions]] to keep your run energy, and restoring your hitpoints with food while he is invisible. Note that you can also leave via the eastern door at any time and use that as a safe zone to regenerate your health, run energy and prayer if necessary - the boss will have the same amount of health when you re-enter. The boss will eventually reset back to a key if the fight lasts too long.

If Treus moves between the north-western and north-eastern side of the room, you may run back and forth along the northern-most cart track where you only have to dodge one cart. If he moves south, try to hug the cavern walls to avoid the cranes as you approach him.

[[Magic]] is the easiest choice against this boss due to its low [[Magic defence]]; it is also weak to [[Wind spells]] and [[Crumble Undead]]. If you have access to an [[Iban's staff]] (requiring 50 [[Attack]], [[Magic]], and completion of [[Underground Pass]]) it may be more effective, as it hits accurately (especially against this boss) and very high.  Note however that most of your attacks will take place in close to melee range, as the obstacles in the room will block you from attacking the boss at range. You can kill the boss with any [[combat style]] if you have a stronger option due to your combat stats or gear. If using magic, consider bringing along an additional set of defensive armour to switch to while running after the boss to reduce the damage of his [[Ranged]] attack. When he reappears you can switch back to your offensive Magic gear.

As you have limited opportunities to hit him, using a high hitting special attack like the [[dragon dagger]] as a secondary can be useful. Its [[special attack]] hits twice in one go, but this boss will only receive one of those hits before he moves away to a new spot and before you even get to him the second attack from the dagger will automatically hit him. If using melee as your primary attack style, bring the highest-hitting [[melee weapon]] you can use, such as a [[2h sword]] or [[halberd]].

Interestingly, Treus Dayth's attack speed while not teleporting is '''dramatically''' lowered to a 30-tick cycle if he is successfully [[poisoned]]. He is, however, immune to poison damage. You may consider using a [[trident of the swamp]] to apply venom.

'''Note''': It is '''not''' possible to freeze the ghost from moving using Magic or the Zamorak Godsword special attack.

'''Note''': If you die, items will appear inside a grave for 15 minutes. You will need to get another glowing fungus to return. The boss will respawn once you take the key again. If you fail to retrieve your grave in time your items will be at [[Death's Office]].

[[File:Haunted Mine - Fighting Treus Dayth.png|thumb|Fighting [[Treus Dayth]].]]

===Salvation at last===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Crafting|35}} {{Boostable|yes}} to obtain the salve shard from a crystal}}
[[File:Haunted Mine - Crystal mine.png|thumb|220px|The long sought-after Salve crystals.]]
After defeating [[Treus Dayth]], the machinery will stop attacking you. Pick up the innocent-looking key, which no longer resists and is, in fact, the [[crystal-mine key]]. Now, head back east through the door and climb up the stairs back to Level 5. Walk all the way west until you reach another staircase ('''15''') and head down.

The crystal-mine key opens the large door to a room with several [[crystal outcrop]]s in the south-east corner. Use a [[chisel]] to cut a piece from the crystal outcrop ({{SCP|Crafting|35}}). If you forgot your chisel, go back up the lift and pick up the chisel from on top of the crate. You will obtain a [[salve shard]] that can be crafted into a new amulet. Be sure to cut extras for backup!

'''Note''': Mining a mithril ore from the veins on the wall within this room will complete a task in the hard [[Morytania Diary]].

A nearby cart tunnel leads right back to the entrance of the mine and can henceforth be used as a shortcut.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
Speak to [[Vanstrom Klause]], the man sat down in the north-east corner of the [[Hair of the Dog]] tavern in [[Canifis]]. He wants you to deliver some weapons to [[the Myreque]], a group of rebels fighting against the [[vampyres]] that rule over Morytania. If you agree to help Vanstrom, he will also tell you about a boatman in [[Mort'ton]] who is rumoured to be able to show you the Myreque hideout.

===Convincing Cyreg Paddlehorn===
{{Map|align=right|name=Cyreg Paddlehorn|x=3519|y=3284|r=3|mtype=square|caption=Cyreg's location, east of Mort'ton.|width=250|height=250}}
{{Needed|[[Druid pouch]] (must have 5 charges), [[Silver sickle (b)|blessed silver sickle]] (if refilling the pouch), 6  [[plank|normal plank]]s, a [[hammer]], 225 [[steel nails]], [[combat gear]] (for level 97 [[Skeleton Hellhound]]), 10 [[coins]] or [[Ring of Charos(a)]], [[steel longsword]], 2 [[steel sword]]s, [[steel mace]], [[steel warhammer]], [[steel dagger]] (all the steel weapons must be held in your [[inventory]] at the same time). You will also need the planks, unless you have completed the [[Shades of Mort'ton]] quest and opened the general store}}

Go to [[Mort'ton]]. You can walk on foot, but beware that the ghasts on the way will drain charges from your [[Druid pouch]] - you may consider taking six [[Mort myre fungus]] in your inventory so you can refill the pouch when you arrive. If you've unlocked [[Fairy ring|fairy rings]] and have at least 50 [[Agility]], you may skip the Mort Myre Swamp using the fairy ring west of Canifis and entering {{fairycode|bip}}, then using the agility shortcut to arrive south of the swamp.

Find [[Cyreg Paddlehorn]]. He is located on the eastern edge of Mort'ton, near his boat at the bridge leading to the Barrows. Attempt to persuade him to bring you to [[the Myreque]]. Cyreg will be very secretive about how to find them though, so you will have to choose the correct sequence of responses to make him feel guilty in order for him to allow you to use his boat. The steel weapons must all be in the inventory to continue dialogue. Choose the following responses in this order:
#''Well, I guess they'll just die without weapons... (2)''
#''Resourceful enough to get their own steel weapons? (2)''
#''If you don't tell me, their deaths are on your head! (3)''
#''What kind of man are you to say that you don't care? (3)''

He will decline to take you himself, but will allow you to rent his boat provided you prove that you have some defence against the ghasts. He will also request 3 planks to fix his boat and 3 to fix a bridge. The player will show him the [[druid pouch]] with at least five charges. Give him the planks and he will give you directions to the hideout. Finally board the boat to travel to [[The Hollows]]; A [[Ring of Charos(a)]] may be used to avoid paying the 10 gold to rent the boat.

'''Note''': Do not repair the bridge in the next section before you've followed the prior steps, or you will need to do so again.

===Myreque===
[[File:In Search of the Myreque - Bridge repair.png|thumb|250px|Repairing the rope bridge.]]
{{Map|3509,3448|align=right|width=250|height=250|mtype=square|r=3|caption=Location of the doors leading into the Myreque's hideout.}}
Once you land at [[The Hollows]], go north, avoiding the [[ghast]]s, until you see a strange tree. Climb up to see a damaged [[Rope bridge (The Hollows)|rope bridge]]. Mend the bridge as you walk along, which requires 75 [[steel nails]] per [[plank]] (225 steel nails total) and three [[plank]]s, and then climb down the other side of the bridge.

Go north to the strange-looking hollow tree and talk to [[Curpile Fyod]] out front. Tell him you've brought the weapons for [[the Myreque]] and then answer some questions for him to prove that you are indeed telling the truth. 
Here are the answers to the possible questions:
{| class="wikitable"
!Question
!Answer
|-
|'' Name the only female member of the Myreque.''||Sani Piliu
|-
|''Who is the leader of the Myreque in Mort Myre?''||Veliaf Hurtz
|-
|''What is the name of the boatman who helps the Myreque?''||Cyreg Paddlehorn
|-
|''Which member of the Myreque was originally a scholar?''||Polmafi Ferdygris
|-
|''Who is the youngest member of the Myreque?''||Ivan Strom
|-
|''What vampyre family rules over Morytania?''||Drakan
|}

'''Note''': If you fail to answer the questions correctly, you will be knocked unconscious and wake up at the boat again, but luckily the bridge will still be intact and your druid pouch will not need the full five charges to re-board the boat.

When you have correctly answered the guard's questions, circle around his tree to the north, and the set of doors in the earth there will be unlocked. Enter and proceed to follow the path to the north west. Halfway up there is an eastern alcove. In the south eastern corner there is a hidden cave entrance - click on the wall to enter (you can rotate your camera to see the entrance).

First speak to [[Veliaf Hurtz|Veliaf]], and he will ask you to introduce yourself to the other five members. Initiate a conversation with each member - it isn't necessary to actually ask any questions of them to continue the quest, just say, "I'll be back later", and then talk to another one.

'''Note''': Combat with the [[Skeleton Hellhound]] will begin immediately after you talk to Veliaf, read the next section to read tips on the fight.

Go back and talk to Veliaf again about the weapons, and he will accept them. However...

===Vanstrom Klause===
As you give the weapons, a [[cutscene]] ensues where a strange mist envelopes the room, and Veliaf realises that it is a [[vampyre]]. The mist shifts, revealing [[Vanstrom Klause]], the stranger you were trying to help. He transforms into his vampyre form and kills [[Sani Piliu]] and [[Harold Evans]] with Blood Burst. After performing the murders, Vanstrom disappears, before summoning a level 97 [[Skeleton Hellhound]], his "little gift" to finish off the remaining members. In order to regain [[the Myreque]]'s trust after having lured Vanstrom to them, you must kill the hellhound.
[[File:In Search of the Myreque - Skeleton Hellhound safespot.png|thumb|The safespot for killing the hellhound with magic attacks.]]
After the cutscene ends, the hellhound will immediately attack you. There is a [[safespot]] in the upper eastern corner of the room on the south side of the chair. Using [[Magic]] is recommended as the hellhound has no Magic defence and is weak to [[Earth spells]]. The hellhound only has 55 [[Hitpoints]], but hits fairly hard; lower levels should bring [[food]]. If you have access to [[Protect from Melee]], the fight will be much easier.

'''Note''': You may leave the chamber during the fight, which will cause the hellhound to respawn close to the entrance once you re-enter. Dying in the chamber will cause your gravestone to appear outside of the room. Returning to the area via the boat will not require you to have a druid pouch, and the bridge will not need repairing. Note that if you die, you cannot return via [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|dls}} until the quest is completed.

After defeating the hellhound, talk to Veliaf Hurtz who'll say he needs to speak to his superior in order to instate you into the Myreque; you can also ask him more questions about the Myreque and Vanstrom. Finally, ask him how to leave the hideout; he tells you about a secret passage to [[Canifis]]. 

====The Myreque shortcut====
{{Main|Myreque Hideout}}
[[File:The Hollows map.png|frame|centre|The dungeon underneath [[Hair of the Dog]] Inn houses the [[Myreque Hideout|Myreque's hideout]].]]
{{Map|3495,3464|align=right|width=250|height=250|mtype=square|r=3|caption=The Myreque shortcut can be accessed via the trapdoor behind the Canifis pub.}}
Leave the chamber, and search the wall at the end of the tunnel; it will open. Now, climb up the ladder.

'''Note:''' Exiting through the trap door is a requirement of the quest. Exiting through any other method will require travelling here again to complete the quest.

You will surface south of the tavern. The nearby trapdoor leads back to the cave, which you can use as an alternate route back to [[Mort'ton]] in the future.

Proceed back into the tavern and seek out [[Vanstrom Klause]], only to find that Vanstrom isn't there but only a [[Stranger (In Search of the Myreque)|Stranger]]. Speak to him to complete the quest.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
